sourceRange.text: 十一月庚辰，大赦天下。是日，丁貴嬪薨。辛巳，夏侯亶、胡龍牙、元樹、曹世宗等衆軍剋壽陽城。丁亥，放魏揚州刺史李憲還北。以壽陽置豫州，合肥改爲南豫州。以中護軍夏侯亶爲豫、南豫二州刺史。平西將軍、郢州刺史元樹進號安西將軍。魏新野太守以郡降。大通元年春正月乙丑，以尚書左僕射徐勉爲尚書僕射、中衛將軍。詔曰：「朕思利兆民，惟日不足，氣象環回，每弘優簡。百官俸祿，本有定數，前代以來，皆多評准，頃者因循，未遑改革。自今已後，可長給見錢，依時卽出，勿令逋緩。凡散失官物，不問多少，並從原宥。惟事涉軍儲，取公私見物，不在此例。」辛未，輿駕親祠南郊。詔曰：「奉時昭事，虔薦蒼璧，思承天德，惠此下民。凡因事去土，流移他境者，並聽復宅業，蠲役五年。尤貧之家，勿收三調。孝悌力田賜爵一級。」是月，司州刺史夏侯夔進軍三關，所至皆剋。

context.beforeSource: 冬十月辛未，以丹陽尹、湘東王繹爲荊州刺史。
context.afterSource: 三月辛未，輿駕幸同泰寺捨身。

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月庚辰，大赦天下。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengchen day, there was a general amnesty throughout the realm.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengchen day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

manualTranslations.zh: 是日，丁貴嬪薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On this day, Honored Concubine Ding died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That day, Honored Concubine Ding died.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛巳，夏侯亶、胡龍牙、元樹、曹世宗等衆軍剋壽陽城。
manualTranslations.literal: On xinsi day, Xiahou Dan, Hu Longya, Yuan Shu, Cao Shizong, and the other armies captured the city of Shouyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Xiahou Dan, Hu Longya, Yuan Shu, Cao Shizong, and the other armies captured Shouyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁亥，放魏揚州刺史李憲還北。
manualTranslations.literal: On dinghai day, Wei Inspector of Yangzhou Li Xian was released to return north.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Li Xian, Wei inspector of Yangzhou, was released to return north.

manualTranslations.zh: 以壽陽置豫州，合肥改爲南豫州。
manualTranslations.literal: Shouyang was used to establish Yuzhou, and Hefei was changed to Southern Yuzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuzhou was established at Shouyang, and Hefei was renamed Southern Yuzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 以中護軍夏侯亶爲豫、南豫二州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Central Protector of the Army Xiahou Dan was made inspector of the two provinces Yu and Southern Yu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiahou Dan, central protector of the army, was made inspector of Yu and Southern Yu provinces.

manualTranslations.zh: 平西將軍、郢州刺史元樹進號安西將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yingzhou Yuan Shu was advanced in title to General Who Stabilizes the West.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuan Shu, general who pacifies the west and inspector of Yingzhou, was advanced to general who stabilizes the west.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏新野太守以郡降。
manualTranslations.literal: The Wei administrator of Xinye surrendered with his commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Wei administrator of Xinye surrendered his commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 大通元年春正月乙丑，以尚書左僕射徐勉爲尚書僕射、中衛將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In spring, in the first month of the first year of Datong, on yichou day, Xu Mian, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, was made director of the Masters of Writing and general of the central guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month of the first year of Datong, on yichou day, Xu Mian, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, was made director of the Masters of Writing and general of the central guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔曰：「朕思利兆民，惟日不足，氣象環回，每弘優簡。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict said: "We think of benefiting the countless people and find each day insufficient; as the seasons revolve, We always extend leniency and simplification.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict said: "We think constantly of benefiting the people and find each day too short; as the seasons turn, We always broaden leniency and simplify burdens.

manualTranslations.zh: 百官俸祿，本有定數，前代以來，皆多評准，頃者因循，未遑改革。
manualTranslations.literal: The stipends and salaries of the hundred officials originally had fixed amounts; since former ages, many have all been assessed by valuation, and recently this has been followed without time for reform.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The stipends of the officials originally had fixed amounts, but since earlier dynasties many have been reckoned by assessed value; recently we have followed that practice and had no time to reform it.

manualTranslations.zh: 自今已後，可長給見錢，依時卽出，勿令逋緩。
manualTranslations.literal: From now on, ready cash may regularly be issued, paid out according to the proper time, and not allowed to fall into arrears or delay.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From now on, let ready cash be issued regularly and on schedule, with no arrears or delay.

manualTranslations.zh: 凡散失官物，不問多少，並從原宥。
manualTranslations.literal: In all cases where government property has been scattered or lost, regardless of amount, all shall be pardoned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whenever government property has been lost, regardless of the amount, all such cases shall be pardoned.

manualTranslations.zh: 惟事涉軍儲，取公私見物，不在此例。」
manualTranslations.literal: Only matters involving military stores or taking existing public or private goods are not within this rule."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Only cases involving military stores or the seizure of existing public or private goods are excluded from this rule."

manualTranslations.zh: 辛未，輿駕親祠南郊。
manualTranslations.literal: On xinwei day, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the emperor personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔曰：「奉時昭事，虔薦蒼璧，思承天德，惠此下民。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict said: "Serving brightly according to the season, reverently offering the azure jade, We think to receive Heaven's virtue and bring grace to these lower people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict said: "In reverent seasonal service We offer the azure jade, seeking to receive Heaven's virtue and extend grace to the people below.

manualTranslations.zh: 凡因事去土，流移他境者，並聽復宅業，蠲役五年。
manualTranslations.literal: All who left their native soil because of affairs and were displaced to other territories shall all be allowed to return to their homes and occupations, and their service shall be remitted for five years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All who left their native places because of events and migrated elsewhere may return to their homes and livelihoods, with service obligations remitted for five years.

manualTranslations.zh: 尤貧之家，勿收三調。
manualTranslations.literal: For especially poor households, do not collect the three levies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From especially poor households, do not collect the three levies.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝悌力田賜爵一級。」
manualTranslations.literal: Those who are filial, fraternal, and diligent in farming shall be granted one rank of nobility."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those known for filial piety, brotherly respect, and diligent farming shall receive one rank of nobility."

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，司州刺史夏侯夔進軍三關，所至皆剋。
manualTranslations.literal: This month, Sizhou Inspector Xiahou Kui advanced his army to the Three Passes, and wherever he arrived he captured them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month, Xiahou Kui, inspector of Sizhou, advanced on the Three Passes and captured every place he reached.

sourceRange.text: 四月乙巳，益州刺史、新除假黃鉞、太尉武陵王紀竊位於蜀，改號天正元年。世祖遣兼司空蕭泰、祠部尚書樂子雲拜謁塋陵，脩復社廟。丁巳，世祖令曰：「軍容不入國，國容不入軍。雖子產獻捷，戎服從事，亞夫弗拜，義止將兵。今凶醜殲夷，逆徒殄潰，九有旣截，四海乂安。漢官威儀，方陳盛禮，衛多君子，寄是式瞻。便可解嚴，以時宣勒。」是月，以東陽太守張彪爲安東將軍。

context.beforeSource: 」辛卯，宣猛將軍朱買臣密害豫章嗣王棟，及其二弟橋、樛，世祖志也。

manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth month, on yisi day, Ji, Prince of Wuling, inspector of Yizhou, newly appointed acting bearer of the yellow axe and grand commandant, usurped the throne in Shu and changed the era name to the first year of Tianzheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on yisi day, Ji, Prince of Wuling, inspector of Yizhou and newly appointed acting bearer of the yellow axe and grand commandant, usurped the throne in Shu and changed the era name to Tianzheng 1.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖遣兼司空蕭泰、祠部尚書樂子雲拜謁塋陵，脩復社廟。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Yuan sent acting Minister of Works Xiao Tai and Minister of the Sacrificial Bureau Yue Ziyun to pay respects at the tombs and restore the altars and temples.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Yuan sent Xiao Tai, acting minister of works, and Yue Ziyun, minister of the sacrificial bureau, to pay respects at the tombs and restore the altars and temples.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁巳，世祖令曰：「軍容不入國，國容不入軍。
manualTranslations.literal: On dingsi day, Emperor Yuan issued an order: "The forms of the army do not enter the state, and the forms of the state do not enter the army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Emperor Yuan issued an order: "Military forms do not enter civil government, and civil forms do not enter the army.

manualTranslations.zh: 雖子產獻捷，戎服從事，亞夫弗拜，義止將兵。
manualTranslations.literal: Although Zichan presented victory and conducted affairs in martial dress, and Yafu did not bow, the principle stopped at commanding troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Though Zichan reported victory in military dress, and Zhou Yafu refused to bow, those precedents went no further than the command of troops.

manualTranslations.zh: 今凶醜殲夷，逆徒殄潰，九有旣截，四海乂安。
manualTranslations.literal: Now the wicked have been destroyed, the rebel band has collapsed, the nine regions are already ordered, and the four seas are governed and at peace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now the wicked have been destroyed, the rebels have collapsed, the nine regions are ordered, and the four seas are at peace.

manualTranslations.zh: 漢官威儀，方陳盛禮，衛多君子，寄是式瞻。
manualTranslations.literal: The dignified rites of Han officialdom are about to display grand ceremony; as Wei had many gentlemen, this is entrusted as a model to behold.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The dignified forms of Han officialdom are about to be set out in grand ceremony; as Wei had many gentlemen, let this serve as the model to look to.

manualTranslations.zh: 便可解嚴，以時宣勒。」
manualTranslations.literal: The state of alert may now be lifted, and commands shall be proclaimed at the proper time."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The alert may now be lifted, and commands should be proclaimed at the proper time."

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，以東陽太守張彪爲安東將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: This month, Dongyang Administrator Zhang Biao was made General Who Pacifies the East.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month, Zhang Biao, administrator of Dongyang, was made general who pacifies the east.

manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Jing, personal name Fangzhi, style Huixiang, childhood name Fazhen, was the ninth son of Emperor Yuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing, personal name Fangzhi, style name Huixiang and childhood name Fazhen, was the ninth son of Emperor Yuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 太清三年，封興梁侯。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Taiqing, he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xingliang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Taiqing 3, he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xingliang.

manualTranslations.zh: 承聖元年，封晉安王，邑二千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Chengsheng, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Jin'an, with a fief of two thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Chengsheng 1, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Jin'an with a fief of two thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，出爲平南將軍、江州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, he was sent out as General Who Pacifies the South and inspector of Jiangzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, he was posted as general who pacifies the south and inspector of Jiangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年十一月，江陵陷，太尉揚州刺史王僧辯、司空南徐州刺史陳霸先定議，以帝爲太宰、承製，奉迎還京師。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year, Jiangling fell; Grand Commandant and Yangzhou Inspector Wang Sengbian and Minister of Works and South Xuzhou Inspector Chen Baxian settled their plan, made the emperor Grand Steward to act under imperial authority, and respectfully welcomed him back to the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the third year, Jiangling fell. Wang Sengbian, grand commandant and inspector of Yangzhou, and Chen Baxian, minister of works and inspector of South Xuzhou, agreed on a plan: the emperor would serve as grand steward, acting with imperial authority, and be escorted back to the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年二月癸丑，至自尋陽，入居朝堂。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year, on guichou day, he arrived from Xunyang and entered to reside in the court hall.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year, on guichou day, he arrived from Xunyang and took up residence in the court hall.

manualTranslations.zh: 以太尉王僧辯爲中書監、錄尚書、驃騎將軍、都督中外諸軍事。
manualTranslations.literal: Grand Commandant Wang Sengbian was made Director of the Secretariat, Manager of the Masters of Writing, General of Agile Cavalry, and commander-in-chief of all military affairs within and without.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Sengbian, grand commandant, was made director of the secretariat, manager of the Masters of Writing, general of agile cavalry, and commander-in-chief of all armies within and without.

manualTranslations.zh: 加司空陳霸先班劍三十人。
manualTranslations.literal: Minister of Works Chen Baxian was granted thirty sword-bearing attendants.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian, minister of works, was granted thirty sword-bearing attendants.

manualTranslations.zh: 以豫州刺史侯瑱爲江州刺史，儀同三司、湘州刺史蕭循爲太尉，儀同三司、廣州刺史蕭勃爲司徒，鎮東將軍張彪爲郢州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Yuzhou Inspector Hou Tian was made Jiangzhou inspector; Xiao Xun, Ceremonial Equal to the Three Dukes and inspector of Xiangzhou, was made grand commandant; Xiao Bo, Ceremonial Equal to the Three Dukes and inspector of Guangzhou, was made minister over the masses; and General Who Guards the East Zhang Biao was made inspector of Yingzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hou Tian, inspector of Yuzhou, was made inspector of Jiangzhou; Xiao Xun, with honors equal to the Three Dukes and inspector of Xiangzhou, became grand commandant; Xiao Bo, with honors equal to the Three Dukes and inspector of Guangzhou, became minister over the masses; and Zhang Biao, general who guards the east, became inspector of Yingzhou.

sourceRange.text: 建武五年，高祖爲雍州刺史，先之鎮，後乃迎后。至州未幾，永元元年八月殂于襄陽官舍，時年三十二。其年歸葬南徐州南東海武進縣東城里山。中興二年，齊朝進高祖位相國，封十郡，梁公，詔贈后爲梁公妃。高祖踐阼，追崇爲皇后。有司議諡，吏部尚書兼右僕射臣約議曰：「表號垂名，義昭不朽。先皇后應祥月德，比載坤靈，柔範陰化，儀形自遠。俔天作合，義先造舟，而神猷夙掩，所隔升運。宜式遵景行，用昭大典。謹按《諡法》，忠和純備曰德，貴而好禮曰德。宜崇曰德皇后。」詔從之。陵曰脩陵。

context.beforeSource: 生永興公主玉姚，永世公主玉婉，永康公主玉嬛。
context.afterSource: 后父燁，詔贈金紫光祿大夫。
context.beforeLocal: 生永興公主玉姚，永世公主玉婉，永康公主玉嬛。

manualTranslations.zh: 建武五年，高祖爲雍州刺史，先之鎮，後乃迎后。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year of Jianwu, when Gaozu became inspector of Yongzhou, he first went to his garrison and only afterward welcomed the empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Jianwu 5, when Gaozu became inspector of Yongzhou, he went to his post first and welcomed the empress afterward.

manualTranslations.zh: 至州未幾，永元元年八月殂于襄陽官舍，時年三十二。
manualTranslations.literal: Not long after she reached the province, in the eighth month of the first year of Yongyuan, she died at the official residence in Xiangyang, aged thirty-two.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Not long after reaching the province, she died in the official residence at Xiangyang in the eighth month of Yongyuan 1, aged thirty-two.

manualTranslations.zh: 其年歸葬南徐州南東海武進縣東城里山。
manualTranslations.literal: That year she was returned for burial at Dongchengli Mountain in Wujin county, South Donghai, South Xuzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year her remains were returned for burial on Dongchengli Mountain in Wujin county, South Donghai commandery, South Xuzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 中興二年，齊朝進高祖位相國，封十郡，梁公，詔贈后爲梁公妃。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Zhongxing, the Qi court advanced Gaozu to the post of chancellor of state and enfeoffed him over ten commanderies as Duke of Liang; an edict posthumously presented the empress as consort of the Duke of Liang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhongxing 2, the Qi court advanced Gaozu to chancellor of state and enfeoffed him over ten commanderies as Duke of Liang; by edict, she was posthumously made consort of the Duke of Liang.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖踐阼，追崇爲皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu ascended the throne, she was posthumously exalted as empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne, she was posthumously honored as empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 有司議諡，吏部尚書兼右僕射臣約議曰：「表號垂名，義昭不朽。
manualTranslations.literal: The responsible offices deliberated on her posthumous title, and your servant Yue, minister of personnel and acting right vice director, stated in deliberation: "To display a title and transmit a name is a principle that makes immortality manifest.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the offices deliberated on her posthumous title, your servant Yue, minister of personnel and acting right vice director, argued: "To set forth a title and pass down a name makes the principle of immortality clear.

manualTranslations.zh: 先皇后應祥月德，比載坤靈，柔範陰化，儀形自遠。
manualTranslations.literal: The former empress answered auspiciousness and lunar virtue, matched and bore the spirit of Earth; her gentle model and yin transformation, her form and example, reached far of themselves.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The late empress answered auspicious signs and lunar virtue, bearing the spirit of Earth; her gentle model and womanly influence formed an example that reached far.

manualTranslations.zh: 俔天作合，義先造舟，而神猷夙掩，所隔升運。
manualTranslations.literal: As Heaven made the match, the rite preceded the building of boats, yet her divine plan was early hidden, and she was separated from the rising fortune.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Heaven made the match and the rite preceded the crossing, yet her divine course was hidden early, cutting her off from the dynasty's rising fortune.

manualTranslations.zh: 宜式遵景行，用昭大典。
manualTranslations.literal: It is proper to follow her bright conduct as a model and thereby make the great ceremony manifest.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We should follow her luminous conduct as our model and make the great ceremony clear.

manualTranslations.zh: 謹按《諡法》，忠和純備曰德，貴而好禮曰德。
manualTranslations.literal: I respectfully note that according to the Rules for Posthumous Titles, loyal, harmonious, pure, and complete is called De; noble yet loving ritual is called De.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: According to the Rules for Posthumous Titles, one loyal, harmonious, pure, and complete is called De; one noble and fond of ritual is also called De.

manualTranslations.zh: 宜崇曰德皇后。」
manualTranslations.literal: She should be exalted as Empress De."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She should be honored as Empress De."

manualTranslations.zh: 詔從之。
manualTranslations.literal: The edict followed this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The edict followed this recommendation.

manualTranslations.zh: 陵曰脩陵。
manualTranslations.literal: Her mausoleum was called Xiuling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Her mausoleum was called Xiuling.

sourceRange.text: 十二月，拜湘東王妃。

localRange.text: 天監十六年十二月，拜湘東王妃。

sourceRange.text: 后幼而柔明淑德，叔父暕見之曰：「吾家女師也。」天監十一年，拜晉安王妃。生哀太子大器，南郡王大連，長山公主妙䂮。中大通三年十月，拜皇太子妃。太清三年三月，薨于永福省，時年四十五。其年，太宗卽位，追崇爲皇后，諡曰簡。大寶元年九月，葬莊陵。先是詔曰：「簡皇后窀穸有期。昔西京霸陵，因山爲藏；東漢壽陵，流水而已。朕屬值時艱，歲饑民弊，方欲以身率下，永示敦朴。今所營莊陵，務存約儉。」又詔金紫光祿大夫蕭子范爲哀策文。

manualTranslations.zh: 后幼而柔明淑德，叔父暕見之曰：「吾家女師也。」
manualTranslations.literal: From youth the empress was gentle, bright, and virtuous; when her uncle Jian saw her, he said, "She is the female model of our house."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth the empress was gentle, intelligent, and virtuous. When her uncle Jian saw her, he said, "She is the model woman of our house."

manualTranslations.zh: 天監十一年，拜晉安王妃。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh year of Tianjian, she was appointed consort of the Prince of Jin'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjian 11, she was appointed consort of the Prince of Jin'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 生哀太子大器，南郡王大連，長山公主妙䂮。
manualTranslations.literal: She gave birth to Crown Prince Ai Daqi, Prince Dalian of Nanjun, and Princess Miao䂮 of Changshan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She bore Daqi, Crown Prince Ai, Dalian, Prince of Nanjun, and Princess Miao䂮 of Changshan.

manualTranslations.zh: 中大通三年十月，拜皇太子妃。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year of Zhongdatong, she was appointed crown princess.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Zhongdatong 3, she was appointed crown princess.

manualTranslations.zh: 太清三年三月，薨于永福省，時年四十五。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month of the third year of Taiqing, she died at Yongfu Office, aged forty-five.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month of Taiqing 3, she died at Yongfu Office, aged forty-five.

manualTranslations.zh: 其年，太宗卽位，追崇爲皇后，諡曰簡。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, when Taizong took the throne, she was posthumously exalted as empress, with the posthumous title Jian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year Taizong took the throne and posthumously honored her as empress, with the title Jian.

manualTranslations.zh: 大寶元年九月，葬莊陵。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Dabao, she was buried in Zhuangling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Dabao 1, she was buried in Zhuangling.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是詔曰：「簡皇后窀穸有期。
manualTranslations.literal: Before this, an edict said: "The interment of Empress Jian has its appointed time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before this, an edict said: "The time has been set for Empress Jian's burial.

manualTranslations.zh: 昔西京霸陵，因山爲藏；
manualTranslations.literal: Formerly, at Baling of the Western Capital, the mountain was used as the tomb;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the past, Baling in the Western Capital used the mountain itself as the tomb;

manualTranslations.zh: 東漢壽陵，流水而已。
manualTranslations.literal: at Shouling of the Eastern Han, there was only flowing water.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: at Shouling of the Eastern Han, there was nothing more than flowing water.

manualTranslations.zh: 朕屬值時艱，歲饑民弊，方欲以身率下，永示敦朴。
manualTranslations.literal: We have encountered hard times; the year is hungry and the people exhausted. We now wish to lead those below by Our own person and forever show sincerity and simplicity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We have met difficult times: the year is hungry and the people worn down. We wish to lead those below by personal example and show lasting sincerity and simplicity.

manualTranslations.zh: 今所營莊陵，務存約儉。」
manualTranslations.literal: Now in constructing Zhuangling, be sure to preserve restraint and frugality."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In building Zhuangling, keep strictly to restraint and frugality."

manualTranslations.zh: 又詔金紫光祿大夫蕭子范爲哀策文。
manualTranslations.literal: Another edict ordered Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon Xiao Zifan to compose the mourning elegy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered Xiao Zifan, grand master for splendid happiness with gold seal and purple ribbon, to compose the mourning elegy.

sourceRange.text: 初，后嘗於室內，忽見庭前昌蒲生花，光彩照灼，非世中所有。后驚視，謂侍者曰：「汝見不？」對曰：「不見。」后曰：「嘗聞見者當富貴。」因遽取吞之。是月產高祖。將產之夜，后見庭內若有衣冠陪列焉。次生衡陽宣王暢、義興昭長公主令嫕。宋泰始七年，殂于秣陵縣同夏里舍，葬武進縣東城里山。天監元年五月甲辰，追上尊號爲皇后。諡曰獻。

context.beforeSource: 后，宋元嘉中嬪於文帝，生長沙宣武王懿、永陽昭王敷，次生高祖。
context.afterSource: 父穆之，字思靜，晉司空華六世孫。
context.beforeLocal: 后，宋元嘉中嬪於文帝，生長沙宣武王懿、永陽昭王敷，次生高祖。
context.afterLocal: 父穆之，字思靜，晉司空華六世孫。

manualTranslations.zh: 初，后嘗於室內，忽見庭前昌蒲生花，光彩照灼，非世中所有。
manualTranslations.literal: At first, the empress was once indoors when she suddenly saw calamus blooming before the courtyard, its radiance bright and dazzling, unlike anything in the world.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Once, while the empress was indoors, she suddenly saw calamus blooming before the courtyard, radiant and dazzling beyond anything in the world.

manualTranslations.zh: 后驚視，謂侍者曰：「汝見不？」
manualTranslations.literal: The empress looked in surprise and said to her attendant, "Do you see it?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Startled, the empress looked and asked her attendant, "Do you see it?"

manualTranslations.zh: 對曰：「不見。」
manualTranslations.literal: The attendant replied, "I do not see it."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The attendant replied, "I do not."

manualTranslations.zh: 后曰：「嘗聞見者當富貴。」
manualTranslations.literal: The empress said, "I have heard that one who sees such a thing will become rich and noble."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The empress said, "I have heard that whoever sees such a thing is destined for wealth and honor."

manualTranslations.zh: 因遽取吞之。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon she hurriedly took it and swallowed it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She immediately took it and swallowed it.

manualTranslations.zh: 是月產高祖。
manualTranslations.literal: That month she gave birth to Gaozu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month she gave birth to Gaozu.

manualTranslations.zh: 將產之夜，后見庭內若有衣冠陪列焉。
manualTranslations.literal: On the night when she was about to give birth, the empress saw in the courtyard what seemed to be robed and capped attendants arrayed there.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the night before the birth, the empress saw what looked like robed and capped attendants lined up in the courtyard.

manualTranslations.zh: 次生衡陽宣王暢、義興昭長公主令嫕。
manualTranslations.literal: Afterward she gave birth to Prince Xuan Chang of Hengyang and Senior Princess Zhao Lingyi of Yixing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She next bore Chang, Prince Xuan of Hengyang, and Lingyi, Senior Princess Zhao of Yixing.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋泰始七年，殂于秣陵縣同夏里舍，葬武進縣東城里山。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh year of Song Taishi, she died at the residence in Tongxia ward, Moling county, and was buried at Dongchengli Mountain in Wujin county.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Song Taishi 7, she died at the residence in Tongxia ward, Moling county, and was buried on Dongchengli Mountain in Wujin county.

manualTranslations.zh: 天監元年五月甲辰，追上尊號爲皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Tianjian, on jiachen day, an exalted title was posthumously presented to her as empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Tianjian 1, on jiachen day, she was posthumously elevated as empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 諡曰獻。
manualTranslations.literal: Her posthumous title was Xian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Her posthumous title was Xian.

items.sourceTextOverride: 昭明太子統字德施，高祖長子也。母曰丁貴嬪。初，高祖未有男，義師起，太子以齊中興元年九月生于襄陽。高祖旣受禪，有司奏立儲副，高祖以天下始定，百度多闕，未之許也。羣臣固請，天監元年十一月，立爲皇太子。時太子年幼，依舊居於內，拜東宮官屬文武，皆入直永福省。

manualTranslations.literal: Crown Prince Zhaoming, Tong, styled Deshi, was Gaozu's eldest son.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Zhaoming, Tong, styled Deshi, was Gaozu's eldest son.

manualTranslations.zh: 母曰丁貴嬪。
manualTranslations.literal: His mother was Honored Concubine Ding.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His mother was Honored Concubine Ding.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，高祖未有男，義師起，太子以齊中興元年九月生于襄陽。
manualTranslations.literal: At first Gaozu had no sons; when the righteous army arose, the crown prince was born at Xiangyang in the ninth month of Qi Zhongxing 1.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first Gaozu had no sons; when the righteous army arose, the crown prince was born at Xiangyang in the ninth month of Qi Zhongxing 1.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖旣受禪，有司奏立儲副，高祖以天下始定，百度多闕，未之許也。
manualTranslations.literal: After Gaozu accepted the abdication, the offices memorialized asking to establish an heir. Because the realm had only just been settled and many institutions were still lacking, Gaozu did not yet approve it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Gaozu accepted the abdication, the offices memorialized asking to establish an heir. Because the realm had only just been settled and many institutions were still lacking, Gaozu did not yet approve it.

manualTranslations.zh: 羣臣固請，天監元年十一月，立爲皇太子。
manualTranslations.literal: The assembled ministers insisted, and in the eleventh month of Tianjian 1 he was established as crown prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The assembled ministers insisted, and in the eleventh month of Tianjian 1 he was established as crown prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 時太子年幼，依舊居於內，拜東宮官屬文武，皆入直永福省。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the crown prince was young and continued, as before, to live inside the palace; the civil and military officials appointed to the Eastern Palace all entered on duty in Yongfu Office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time the crown prince was young and continued, as before, to live inside the palace; the civil and military officials appointed to the Eastern Palace all entered on duty in Yongfu Office.

sourceRange.text: 愍懷太子方矩，字德規，世祖第四子也。初封南安縣侯，隨世祖在荊鎮。太清初，爲使持節、督湘郢桂寧成合羅七州諸軍事、鎮南將軍、湘州刺史。尋𢖜爲侍中、中衛將軍，給鼓吹一部。世祖承制，拜王太子，改名元良。承聖元年十一月丙子，立爲皇太子。及西魏師陷荊城，太子與世祖同爲魏人所害。

context.beforeSource: 承聖元年四月，追諡哀太子。
context.afterSource: 太子聰穎，頗有世祖風，而凶暴猜忌。

sourceRange.text: 中興元年，西臺選爲黃門郎，遷冠軍將軍、征東長史。從軍東下，身先士卒。高祖行營壘，見慶遠頓舍嚴整，每歎曰：「人人若是，吾又何憂。」建康城平，入爲侍中，領前軍將軍，帶淮陵、齊昌二郡太守。城內嘗夜失火，禁中驚懼，高祖時居宮中，悉斂諸鑰，問「柳侍中何在」。慶遠至，悉付之。其見任如此。

context.beforeSource: 及義兵起，慶遠常居帷幄爲謀主。
context.afterSource: 霸府建，以爲太尉從事中郎。

manualTranslations.zh: 中興元年，西臺選爲黃門郎，遷冠軍將軍、征東長史。
manualTranslations.literal: In Zhongxing 1, the western court selected him as Yellow Gate Gentleman; he was transferred to Champion General and chief clerk of the General Who Campaigns East.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhongxing 1, the western court selected him as Yellow Gate Gentleman; he was transferred to Champion General and chief clerk of the General Who Campaigns East.

manualTranslations.zh: 從軍東下，身先士卒。
manualTranslations.literal: He accompanied the army eastward and personally went ahead of the officers and troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He accompanied the army eastward and personally went ahead of the officers and troops.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖行營壘，見慶遠頓舍嚴整，每歎曰：「人人若是，吾又何憂。」
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu inspected the camps and saw Qingyuan's quarters arranged in strict order, he often sighed, "If everyone were like this, what would I have to worry about?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu inspected the camps and saw Qingyuan's quarters arranged in strict order, he often sighed, "If everyone were like this, what would I have to worry about?"

manualTranslations.zh: 建康城平，入爲侍中，領前軍將軍，帶淮陵、齊昌二郡太守。
manualTranslations.literal: After Jiankang was pacified, Qingyuan entered court as Attendant-in-Ordinary, concurrently General of the Front Army and administrator of Huailing and Qichang commanderies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Jiankang was pacified, Qingyuan entered court as Attendant-in-Ordinary, concurrently General of the Front Army and administrator of Huailing and Qichang commanderies.

manualTranslations.zh: 城內嘗夜失火，禁中驚懼，高祖時居宮中，悉斂諸鑰，問「柳侍中何在」。
manualTranslations.literal: Once a fire broke out in the city at night and those inside the palace were alarmed. Gaozu was then living in the palace; he gathered all the keys and asked, "Where is Attendant Liu?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Once a fire broke out in the city at night and those inside the palace were alarmed. Gaozu was then living in the palace; he gathered all the keys and asked, "Where is Attendant Liu?"

manualTranslations.zh: 慶遠至，悉付之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Qingyuan arrived, Gaozu handed them all over to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Qingyuan arrived, Gaozu handed them all over to him.

manualTranslations.zh: 其見任如此。
manualTranslations.literal: Such was the trust placed in him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Such was the trust placed in him.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lu Xiulie, administrator of Baxi, and others led linked forces from Ba and Shu to raid Shangming, so Daogong was made Envoy Holding Credentials and commander of the armies for the western campaign.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he camped at Tutai and joined battle with the rebels, Daogong secretly sent surprise troops behind them and crushed them in a single engagement; Xiulie and the others surrendered at the army gate.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: For this merit he was promoted to Commander of the Central Army, but he firmly declined and did not accept; he then went out as Envoy Holding Credentials, Right General, and inspector of Sizhou.

sourceRange.text: 和帝卽位，授假節、冠軍將軍、平越中郎將、廣州刺史，遷給事黃門侍郎，移鎮南堂西渚。中興元年七月，郢城降，以本號爲益州刺史，仍爲前軍，先定尋陽。及大軍進至京邑，元起築壘于建陽門，與王茂、曹景宗等合長圍，身當鋒鏑。建康城平，進號征虜將軍。天監初，封當陽縣侯，邑一千二百戶。又進號左將軍，刺史如故，始述職焉。

sourceRange.text: 東昏末，淹以秘書監兼衛尉，固辭不獲免，遂親職。謂人曰：「此非吾任，路人所知，正取吾空名耳。且天時人事，尋當飜覆。孔子曰：『有文事者必有武備。』臨事圖之，何憂之有？」頃之，又副領軍王瑩。及義師至新林，淹微服來奔，高祖板爲冠軍將軍，秘書監如故，尋兼司徒左長史。中興元年，遷吏部尚書。二年，轉相國右長史，冠軍將軍如故。天監元年，爲散騎常侍、左衛將軍，封臨沮縣開國伯，食邑四百戶。淹乃謂子弟曰：「吾本素宦，不求富貴，今之忝竊，遂至於此。平生言止足之事，亦以備矣。人生行樂耳，須富貴何時。吾功名旣立，正欲歸身草萊耳。」其年，以疾遷金紫光祿大夫，改封醴陵侯。四年卒，時年六十二。高祖爲素服舉哀。賻錢三萬，布五十匹。諡曰憲伯。

context.beforeSource: 及事平，世服其先見。
context.afterSource: 淹少以文章顯，晚節才思微退，時人皆謂之才盡。

manualTranslations.zh: 東昏末，淹以秘書監兼衛尉，固辭不獲免，遂親職。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of Donghun's reign, Yan, as Palace Library Director, was also made Commandant of the Guards. He firmly declined but could not be excused, and so took up the office himself.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the end of Donghun's reign, Yan, as Palace Library Director, was also made Commandant of the Guards. He firmly declined but could not be excused, and so took up the office himself.

manualTranslations.zh: 謂人曰：「此非吾任，路人所知，正取吾空名耳。
manualTranslations.literal: He told someone, "This is not a post suited to me; even passersby know it. They are simply using my empty name.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He told someone, "This is not a post suited to me; even passersby know it. They are simply using my empty name.

manualTranslations.zh: 且天時人事，尋當飜覆。
manualTranslations.literal: Besides, the timing of Heaven and the affairs of men will soon be overturned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Besides, the timing of Heaven and the affairs of men will soon be overturned.

manualTranslations.zh: 孔子曰：『有文事者必有武備。』
manualTranslations.literal: Confucius said, 'Those who have civil affairs must also have military preparations.'
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Confucius said, 'Those who have civil affairs must also have military preparations.'

manualTranslations.zh: 臨事圖之，何憂之有？」
manualTranslations.literal: If one plans when events arrive, what is there to worry about?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If one plans when events arrive, what is there to worry about?"

manualTranslations.zh: 頃之，又副領軍王瑩。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon afterward he again served as deputy to Wang Ying, Commander of the Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he again served as deputy to Wang Ying, Commander of the Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 及義師至新林，淹微服來奔，高祖板爲冠軍將軍，秘書監如故，尋兼司徒左長史。
manualTranslations.literal: When the righteous army reached Xinlin, Yan came over in plain clothes. Gaozu provisionally appointed him Champion General, leaving him as Palace Library Director as before, and soon made him concurrently left chief clerk to the Minister over the Masses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the righteous army reached Xinlin, Yan came over in plain clothes. Gaozu provisionally appointed him Champion General, leaving him as Palace Library Director as before, and soon made him concurrently left chief clerk to the Minister over the Masses.

manualTranslations.zh: 中興元年，遷吏部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: In Zhongxing 1, he was transferred to Minister of Personnel.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhongxing 1, he was transferred to Minister of Personnel.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，轉相國右長史，冠軍將軍如故。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, he was moved to right chief clerk to the Chancellor of State, remaining Champion General as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, he was moved to right chief clerk to the Chancellor of State, remaining Champion General as before.

manualTranslations.zh: 天監元年，爲散騎常侍、左衛將軍，封臨沮縣開國伯，食邑四百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianjian 1, he became Regular Attendant and Left Guard General, and was enfeoffed as founding Count of Linju county with a fief of four hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjian 1, he became Regular Attendant and Left Guard General, and was enfeoffed as founding Count of Linju county with a fief of four hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 淹乃謂子弟曰：「吾本素宦，不求富貴，今之忝竊，遂至於此。
manualTranslations.literal: Yan then told his sons and younger kinsmen, "I was originally a plain official and did not seek wealth or rank. Now, through undeserved favor, I have reached this point.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yan then told his sons and younger kinsmen, "I was originally a plain official and did not seek wealth or rank. Now, through undeserved favor, I have reached this point.

manualTranslations.zh: 平生言止足之事，亦以備矣。
manualTranslations.literal: What I have said all my life about knowing when to stop is now fully satisfied.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: What I have said all my life about knowing when to stop is now fully satisfied.

manualTranslations.zh: 人生行樂耳，須富貴何時。
manualTranslations.literal: Life is only for taking one's pleasure; when does one need wealth and rank?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Life is only for taking one's pleasure; when does one need wealth and rank?

manualTranslations.zh: 吾功名旣立，正欲歸身草萊耳。」
manualTranslations.literal: Now that my achievements and name are established, I simply wish to return myself to the fields."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now that my achievements and name are established, I simply wish to return myself to the fields."

manualTranslations.zh: 其年，以疾遷金紫光祿大夫，改封醴陵侯。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, because of illness, he was transferred to Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon, and his fief was changed to Marquis of Liling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, because of illness, he was transferred to Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon, and his fief was changed to Marquis of Liling.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年卒，時年六十二。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in the fourth year, aged sixty-two.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the fourth year, aged sixty-two.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖爲素服舉哀。
manualTranslations.literal: Gaozu wore plain mourning dress and held a lamentation for him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozu wore plain mourning dress and held a lamentation for him.

manualTranslations.zh: 賻錢三萬，布五十匹。
manualTranslations.literal: He granted funeral gifts of thirty thousand cash and fifty bolts of cloth.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He granted funeral gifts of thirty thousand cash and fifty bolts of cloth.

manualTranslations.zh: 諡曰憲伯。
manualTranslations.literal: His posthumous title was Xianbo.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Xianbo.

sourceRange.text: 三年元會，詔朏乘小輿升殿。其年，遭母憂，尋有詔攝職如故。後五年，改授中書監、司徒、衛將軍，並固讓不受。遣謁者敦授，乃拜受焉。是冬薨於府，時年六十六。輿駕出臨哭，詔給東園秘器，朝服一具，衣一襲，錢十萬，布百匹，蠟百斤。贈侍中、司徒。諡曰靖孝。朏所著書及文章，並行於世。

context.afterSource: 子諼，官至司徒右長史，坐殺牛免官，卒於家。

manualTranslations.zh: 三年元會，詔朏乘小輿升殿。
manualTranslations.literal: At the New Year court assembly in the third year, an edict allowed Fei to ride a small carriage up into the hall.

manualTranslations.zh: 其年，遭母憂，尋有詔攝職如故。
manualTranslations.literal: That year he went into mourning for his mother; soon an edict ordered him to perform his duties as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year he went into mourning for his mother; soon an edict ordered him to perform his duties as before.

manualTranslations.zh: 後五年，改授中書監、司徒、衛將軍，並固讓不受。
manualTranslations.literal: Five years later, he was reassigned as Director of the Secretariat, Minister over the Masses, and Guard General, but he firmly declined them all and did not accept.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Five years later, he was reassigned as Director of the Secretariat, Minister over the Masses, and Guard General, but he firmly declined them all and did not accept.

manualTranslations.zh: 遣謁者敦授，乃拜受焉。
manualTranslations.literal: An usher was sent to press the appointment, and only then did he bow and accept it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An usher was sent to press the appointment, and only then did he bow and accept it.

manualTranslations.zh: 是冬薨於府，時年六十六。
manualTranslations.literal: That winter he died at his residence, aged sixty-six.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That winter he died at his residence, aged sixty-six.

manualTranslations.zh: 輿駕出臨哭，詔給東園秘器，朝服一具，衣一襲，錢十萬，布百匹，蠟百斤。
manualTranslations.literal: The imperial carriage went out to visit and mourn him. An edict supplied an imperial coffin from Dongyuan, one set of court robes, one suit of clothes, one hundred thousand cash, one hundred bolts of cloth, and one hundred jin of wax.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage went out to visit and mourn him. An edict supplied an imperial coffin from Dongyuan, one set of court robes, one suit of clothes, one hundred thousand cash, one hundred bolts of cloth, and one hundred jin of wax.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈侍中、司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously granted the offices of Attendant-in-Ordinary and Minister over the Masses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the offices of Attendant-in-Ordinary and Minister over the Masses.

manualTranslations.zh: 諡曰靖孝。
manualTranslations.literal: His posthumous title was Jingxiao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Jingxiao.

manualTranslations.zh: 朏所著書及文章，並行於世。
manualTranslations.literal: The books and writings Fei composed all circulated in the world.

sourceRange.text: 」居州少時，遇疾，自表乞還朝，徵爲散騎常侍、左軍將軍。旣至疾甚，中使累加存問。普通元年正月，卒，時年五十八。是日輿駕春祠二廟，旣出宮，有司以聞。高祖問中書舍人朱异曰：「吉凶同日，今行乎？」异對曰：「昔柳莊寢疾，衛獻公當祭，請於尸曰：『有臣柳莊，非寡人之臣，是社稷之臣也，聞其死，請往。』不釋祭服而往，遂以襚之。道根雖未爲社稷之臣，亦有勞王室，臨之禮也。」高祖卽幸其宅，哭之甚慟。詔曰：「豫寧縣開國伯、新除散騎常侍、領左軍將軍馮道根，奉上能忠，有功不伐，撫人留愛，守邊難犯，祭遵、馮異、郭伋、李牧，不能過也。奄致殞喪，惻愴於懷。可贈信威將軍、左衛將軍，給鼓吹一部。賻錢十萬，布百匹。諡曰威。」子懷嗣。

context.beforeSource: 高祖每稱曰：「馮道根所在，能使朝廷不復憶有一州。
context.afterSource: 康絢字長明，華山藍田人也。

manualTranslations.zh: 居州少時，遇疾，自表乞還朝，徵爲散騎常侍、左軍將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: After only a short time in the province, Daogen fell ill and submitted a memorial requesting to return to court; he was summoned as Regular Attendant and Left Army General.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After only a short time in the province, Daogen fell ill and submitted a memorial requesting to return to court; he was summoned as Regular Attendant and Left Army General.

manualTranslations.zh: 旣至疾甚，中使累加存問。
manualTranslations.literal: After he arrived, his illness became severe, and palace envoys repeatedly came to ask after him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After he arrived, his illness became severe, and palace envoys repeatedly came to ask after him.

manualTranslations.zh: 普通元年正月，卒，時年五十八。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of Putong 1, he died, aged fifty-eight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of Putong 1, he died, aged fifty-eight.

manualTranslations.zh: 是日輿駕春祠二廟，旣出宮，有司以聞。
manualTranslations.literal: That day the imperial carriage was setting out for the spring sacrifices at the two ancestral temples; after it had left the palace, the responsible offices reported the news.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That day the imperial carriage was setting out for the spring sacrifices at the two ancestral temples; after it had left the palace, the responsible offices reported the news.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖問中書舍人朱异曰：「吉凶同日，今行乎？」
manualTranslations.literal: Gaozu asked Zhu Yi, Secretariat Drafter, "Auspicious and inauspicious events fall on the same day. Should we go now?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozu asked Zhu Yi, Secretariat Drafter, "Auspicious and inauspicious events fall on the same day. Should we go now?"

manualTranslations.zh: 异對曰：「昔柳莊寢疾，衛獻公當祭，請於尸曰：『有臣柳莊，非寡人之臣，是社稷之臣也，聞其死，請往。』
manualTranslations.literal: Zhu Yi replied, "Formerly, when Liu Zhuang lay ill and Duke Xian of Wei was about to sacrifice, the duke asked the spirit impersonator, saying, 'There is my minister Liu Zhuang; he is not merely my minister, but a minister of the altars of soil and grain. Hearing that he has died, I ask to go.'
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhu Yi replied, "Formerly, when Liu Zhuang lay ill and Duke Xian of Wei was about to sacrifice, the duke asked the spirit impersonator, saying, 'There is my minister Liu Zhuang; he is not merely my minister, but a minister of the altars of soil and grain. Hearing that he has died, I ask to go.'

manualTranslations.zh: 不釋祭服而往，遂以襚之。
manualTranslations.literal: Without removing his sacrificial robes, the duke went and then bestowed burial garments on him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Without removing his sacrificial robes, the duke went and then bestowed burial garments on him.

manualTranslations.zh: 道根雖未爲社稷之臣，亦有勞王室，臨之禮也。」
manualTranslations.literal: Though Daogen was not yet a minister of the altars of soil and grain, he too had labored for the royal house; visiting him is proper ritual."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Though Daogen was not yet a minister of the altars of soil and grain, he too had labored for the royal house; visiting him is proper ritual."

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖卽幸其宅，哭之甚慟。
manualTranslations.literal: Gaozu immediately went to his residence and wept with deep grief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozu immediately went to his residence and wept with deep grief.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔曰：「豫寧縣開國伯、新除散騎常侍、領左軍將軍馮道根，奉上能忠，有功不伐，撫人留愛，守邊難犯，祭遵、馮異、郭伋、李牧，不能過也。
manualTranslations.literal: The edict said, "Feng Daogen, founding Count of Yuning county, newly appointed Regular Attendant and acting Left Army General, served his sovereign with loyalty, had merit without boasting, governed the people and left affection behind, and defended the frontier so that it was hard to violate; Ji Zun, Feng Yi, Guo Ji, and Li Mu could not surpass him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The edict said, "Feng Daogen, founding Count of Yuning county, newly appointed Regular Attendant and acting Left Army General, served his sovereign with loyalty, had merit without boasting, governed the people and left affection behind, and defended the frontier so that it was hard to violate; Ji Zun, Feng Yi, Guo Ji, and Li Mu could not surpass him.

manualTranslations.zh: 奄致殞喪，惻愴於懷。
manualTranslations.literal: That he has suddenly come to death and loss fills Our heart with sorrow.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That he has suddenly come to death and loss fills Our heart with sorrow.

manualTranslations.zh: 可贈信威將軍、左衛將軍，給鼓吹一部。
manualTranslations.literal: He may be posthumously granted the offices of General Who Inspires Trusting Awe and Left Guard General, and given one corps of drummers and pipers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He may be posthumously granted the offices of General Who Inspires Trusting Awe and Left Guard General, and given one corps of drummers and pipers.

manualTranslations.zh: 賻錢十萬，布百匹。
manualTranslations.literal: Grant funeral gifts of one hundred thousand cash and one hundred bolts of cloth.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Grant funeral gifts of one hundred thousand cash and one hundred bolts of cloth.

manualTranslations.zh: 諡曰威。」
manualTranslations.literal: His posthumous title shall be Wei."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His posthumous title shall be Wei."

manualTranslations.zh: 子懷嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Huai inherited.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Huai inherited.

sourceRange.text: 昌義之，歷陽烏江人也。少有武幹。齊代隨曹虎征伐，累有戰功。虎爲雍州，以義之補防閤，出爲馮翊戍主。及虎代還，義之留事高祖。時天下方亂，高祖亦厚遇之。義師起，板爲輔國將軍、軍主，除建安王中兵參軍。時竟陵芊口有邸閣，高祖遣驅，每戰必捷。大軍次新林，隨王茂於新亭，幷朱雀航力戰，斬獲尤多。建康城平，以爲直閤將軍、馬右夾轂主。天監元年，封永豊縣侯，邑五百戶。除驍騎將軍。出爲盱眙太守。二年，遷假節、督北徐州諸軍事、輔國將軍、北徐州刺史，鎮鐘離。魏寇州境，義之擊破之。三年，進號冠軍將軍，增封二百戶。

context.beforeSource: 子悅嗣。
context.afterSource: 四年，大舉北伐，揚州刺史臨川王督衆軍軍洛口，義之以州兵受節度，爲前軍，攻魏梁城戍，克之。

manualTranslations.zh: 昌義之，歷陽烏江人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Chang Yizhi came from Wujiang in Liyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chang Yizhi came from Wujiang in Liyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 少有武幹。
manualTranslations.literal: From youth he had military ability.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth he had military ability.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊代隨曹虎征伐，累有戰功。
manualTranslations.literal: During Qi, he accompanied Cao Hu on campaigns and repeatedly won battle merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Qi, he accompanied Cao Hu on campaigns and repeatedly won battle merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 虎爲雍州，以義之補防閤，出爲馮翊戍主。
manualTranslations.literal: When Hu governed Yongzhou, he appointed Yizhi to the guard staff, then sent him out as garrison commander at Fengyi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Hu governed Yongzhou, he appointed Yizhi to the guard staff, then sent him out as garrison commander at Fengyi.

manualTranslations.zh: 及虎代還，義之留事高祖。
manualTranslations.literal: When Hu was replaced and returned, Yizhi stayed behind to serve Gaozu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Hu was replaced and returned, Yizhi stayed behind to serve Gaozu.

manualTranslations.zh: 時天下方亂，高祖亦厚遇之。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the realm was just falling into disorder, and Gaozu treated him generously.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time the realm was just falling into disorder, and Gaozu treated him generously.

manualTranslations.zh: 義師起，板爲輔國將軍、軍主，除建安王中兵參軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When the righteous army rose, he was provisionally appointed General Who Supports the State and army commander, and was appointed central army aide to the Prince of Jian'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the righteous army rose, he was provisionally appointed General Who Supports the State and army commander, and was appointed central army aide to the Prince of Jian'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 時竟陵芊口有邸閣，高祖遣驅，每戰必捷。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time there were granaries at Qiankou in Jingling; Gaozu sent him to operate there, and he was victorious in every battle.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time there were granaries at Qiankou in Jingling; Gaozu sent him to operate there, and he was victorious in every battle.

manualTranslations.zh: 大軍次新林，隨王茂於新亭，幷朱雀航力戰，斬獲尤多。
manualTranslations.literal: When the main army halted at Xinlin, he followed Wang Mao at Xinting and fought hard at Zhuque Bridge as well, taking especially many heads and captives.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the main army halted at Xinlin, he followed Wang Mao at Xinting and fought hard at Zhuque Bridge as well, taking especially many heads and captives.

manualTranslations.zh: 建康城平，以爲直閤將軍、馬右夾轂主。
manualTranslations.literal: After Jiankang was pacified, he was made Direct-Hall General and commander of the right horsemen flanking the imperial carriage.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Jiankang was pacified, he was made Direct-Hall General and commander of the right horsemen flanking the imperial carriage.

manualTranslations.zh: 天監元年，封永豊縣侯，邑五百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianjian 1, he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yongfeng county, with a fief of five hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjian 1, he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yongfeng county, with a fief of five hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 除驍騎將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: He was appointed General of Agile Cavalry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was appointed General of Agile Cavalry.

manualTranslations.zh: 出爲盱眙太守。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out as administrator of Xuyi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He went out as administrator of Xuyi.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，遷假節、督北徐州諸軍事、輔國將軍、北徐州刺史，鎮鐘離。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, he was transferred as Acting Envoy Holding Credentials, commander of military affairs in North Xuzhou, General Who Supports the State, and inspector of North Xuzhou, garrisoning Zhongli.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, he was transferred as Acting Envoy Holding Credentials, commander of military affairs in North Xuzhou, General Who Supports the State, and inspector of North Xuzhou, garrisoning Zhongli.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏寇州境，義之擊破之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wei raided the provincial borders, Yizhi struck and defeated them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wei raided the provincial borders, Yizhi struck and defeated them.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，進號冠軍將軍，增封二百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, his title was advanced to Champion General and his fief was increased by two hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, his title was advanced to Champion General and his fief was increased by two hundred households.

sourceRange.text: 十八年，徵爲員外散騎常侍，領長水校尉，與護軍韋叡、太子右衛率周捨直殿省。普通元年，除衛尉卿，未拜，卒，時年五十七。輿駕卽日臨哭。贈右衛將軍，給鼓吹一部。賻錢十萬，布百匹。諡曰壯。

sourceRange.text: 明帝卽位，以夬爲郢州治中，有名稱職，以父老去官還鄉里。南康王爲荊州刺史，引爲別駕。義師起，遷西中郎諮議參軍，別駕如故。時西土位望，惟夬與同郡樂藹、劉坦爲州人所推信，故領軍將軍蕭穎胄深相委仗，每事諮焉。高祖師發雍州，穎胄遣夬出自楊口，面稟經略，並護送軍資，高祖甚禮之。中興初，遷御史中丞，以父憂去職。起爲冠軍將軍、衛軍長史。天監元年，遷征虜長史、東海太守，將軍如故。二年，徵爲太子右衛率。是冬，遷五兵尚書，參掌大選。三年，卒，時年四十九。子曜卿嗣。

context.beforeSource: 隆昌末，少帝見誅，寵舊多罹其禍，惟夬及傅昭以清正免。
context.afterSource: 夬從弟岳，有名行，州裏稱之，出於夬右。

manualTranslations.zh: 明帝卽位，以夬爲郢州治中，有名稱職，以父老去官還鄉里。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Ming took the throne, Guai was made administrative aide of Yingzhou. He had a good reputation and was competent in office, but because his father was old he left office and returned to his village.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming took the throne, Guai was made administrative aide of Yingzhou. He had a good reputation and was competent in office, but because his father was old he left office and returned to his village.

manualTranslations.zh: 南康王爲荊州刺史，引爲別駕。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Prince of Nankang became inspector of Jingzhou, he brought Guai in as aide-de-camp.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Nankang became inspector of Jingzhou, he brought Guai in as aide-de-camp.

manualTranslations.zh: 義師起，遷西中郎諮議參軍，別駕如故。
manualTranslations.literal: When the righteous army rose, Guai was promoted to advisory army aide to the Western Central Commandant, while remaining aide-de-camp as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the righteous army rose, Guai was promoted to advisory army aide to the Western Central Commandant, while remaining aide-de-camp as before.

manualTranslations.zh: 時西土位望，惟夬與同郡樂藹、劉坦爲州人所推信，故領軍將軍蕭穎胄深相委仗，每事諮焉。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time, among men of rank and reputation in the western lands, only Guai, Yue Ai, and Liu Tan of the same commandery were trusted and recommended by the people of the province, so General of the Army Xiao Yingzhou relied deeply on them and consulted them on every matter.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time, among men of rank and reputation in the western lands, only Guai, Yue Ai, and Liu Tan of the same commandery were trusted and recommended by the people of the province, so General of the Army Xiao Yingzhou relied deeply on them and consulted them on every matter.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖師發雍州，穎胄遣夬出自楊口，面稟經略，並護送軍資，高祖甚禮之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu's army set out from Yongzhou, Yingzhou sent Guai out by way of Yangkou to receive his strategy in person and escort military supplies; Gaozu treated him with great courtesy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu's army set out from Yongzhou, Yingzhou sent Guai out by way of Yangkou to receive his strategy in person and escort military supplies; Gaozu treated him with great courtesy.

manualTranslations.zh: 中興初，遷御史中丞，以父憂去職。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Zhongxing, Guai was promoted to Palace Assistant Censor, but left office for mourning his father.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhongxing, Guai was promoted to Palace Assistant Censor, but left office for mourning his father.

manualTranslations.zh: 起爲冠軍將軍、衛軍長史。
manualTranslations.literal: He was recalled as Champion General and chief clerk to the Guard General.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was recalled as Champion General and chief clerk to the Guard General.

manualTranslations.zh: 天監元年，遷征虜長史、東海太守，將軍如故。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianjian 1, he was transferred as chief clerk to the General Who Subdues Captives and administrator of Donghai, retaining his general's rank as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjian 1, he was transferred as chief clerk to the General Who Subdues Captives and administrator of Donghai, retaining his general's rank as before.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，徵爲太子右衛率。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, he was summoned to be Crown Prince Right Guard Commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, he was summoned to be Crown Prince Right Guard Commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 是冬，遷五兵尚書，參掌大選。
manualTranslations.literal: That winter he was transferred to Minister of the Five Arms and took part in managing the great selection of officials.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That winter he was transferred to Minister of the Five Arms and took part in managing the great selection of officials.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，卒，時年四十九。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in the third year, aged forty-nine.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the third year, aged forty-nine.

manualTranslations.zh: 子曜卿嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Yaoqing inherited.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Yaoqing inherited.

sourceRange.text: 天監元年，以本官領前軍將軍。其年，遷冠軍將軍、丹陽尹。爲政清靜，去煩苛。京師有寡婦無子，姑亡，舉債以斂葬，旣葬而無以還之。時年饑，每旦爲粥於郡門，以賦百姓，民稱之不容口。三年，爲散騎常侍、中書令，領遊擊將軍。常謂諸子侄曰：「謝莊在宋孝武世，位止中書令，吾自視豈可以過之。」因多謝病，簡通賓客。遷前將軍、太常卿。六年，出爲雲麾將軍、安西始興王長史、南郡太守。明年，遷軍師將軍、平西鄱陽郡王長史、江夏太守，並加秩中二千石。九年，遷爲散騎常侍、金紫光祿大夫。十二年，卒，時年五十四。

context.beforeSource: 梁臺建，遷散騎常侍、中書令。
context.afterSource: 齊遊擊將軍徐希秀亦號能書，常謂志爲「書聖」。
context.beforeLocal: 梁臺建，遷散騎常侍、中書令。
context.afterLocal: 齊遊擊將軍徐希秀亦號能書，常謂志爲「書聖」。

manualTranslations.zh: 天監元年，以本官領前軍將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianjian 1, Zhi, while holding his existing office, concurrently served as General of the Front Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjian 1, Zhi, while holding his existing office, concurrently served as General of the Front Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 其年，遷冠軍將軍、丹陽尹。
manualTranslations.literal: That year he was transferred to Champion General and Intendant of Danyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year he was transferred to Champion General and Intendant of Danyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 爲政清靜，去煩苛。
manualTranslations.literal: His governance was calm and quiet, and he removed vexatious harshness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His governance was calm and quiet, and he removed vexatious harshness.

manualTranslations.zh: 京師有寡婦無子，姑亡，舉債以斂葬，旣葬而無以還之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the capital there was a childless widow whose mother-in-law died. She borrowed money for the coffin and burial, but after the burial she had no means to repay it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the capital there was a childless widow whose mother-in-law died. She borrowed money for the coffin and burial, but after the burial she had no means to repay it.

manualTranslations.zh: 時年饑，每旦爲粥於郡門，以賦百姓，民稱之不容口。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the year was famine-stricken; every morning he made gruel at the commandery gate and distributed it to the people, who praised him without ceasing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time the year was famine-stricken; every morning he made gruel at the commandery gate and distributed it to the people, who praised him without ceasing.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，爲散騎常侍、中書令，領遊擊將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, he became Regular Attendant and Director of the Secretariat, concurrently General Who Roams in Attack.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, he became Regular Attendant and Director of the Secretariat, concurrently General Who Roams in Attack.

manualTranslations.zh: 常謂諸子侄曰：「謝莊在宋孝武世，位止中書令，吾自視豈可以過之。」
manualTranslations.literal: He often told his sons and nephews, "Under Emperor Xiaowu of Song, Xie Zhuang's rank went no higher than Director of the Secretariat. How could I regard myself as able to surpass him?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He often told his sons and nephews, "Under Emperor Xiaowu of Song, Xie Zhuang's rank went no higher than Director of the Secretariat. How could I regard myself as able to surpass him?"

manualTranslations.zh: 因多謝病，簡通賓客。
manualTranslations.literal: After that he often pleaded illness and limited his dealings with guests.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After that he often pleaded illness and limited his dealings with guests.

sourceRange.text: 高祖霸府開，引爲戶曹屬，遷司徒左長史。天監元年，除太子中庶子，領驍騎將軍，入爲侍中。出爲寧朔將軍、中軍長史。又爲侍中，領射聲校尉，遷五兵尚書，加給事中，出爲晉陵太守。徵爲吏部尚書，俄領國子祭酒。暕名公子，少致美稱，及居選曹，職事修理；然世貴顯，與物多隔，不能留心寒素，衆頗謂爲刻薄。遷尚書右僕射，尋加侍中。復遷左僕射，以母憂去官。起爲雲麾將軍、吳郡太守。還爲侍中、尚書左僕射，領國子祭酒。普通四年冬，暴疾卒，時年四十七。詔贈侍中、中書令、中軍將軍，給東園秘器，朝服一具，衣一襲，錢十萬，布百匹。諡曰靖。有四子，訓、承、穉、訏，並通顯。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was summoned to be Minister of Personnel and soon concurrently served as Libationer of the Imperial Academy.

manualTranslations.zh: 暕名公子，少致美稱，及居選曹，職事修理；
manualTranslations.literal: Jian was a famous noble son and won fine praise in youth. When he occupied the selection bureau, official business was orderly;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian was a famous noble son and won fine praise in youth. When he occupied the selection bureau, official business was orderly;

manualTranslations.zh: 然世貴顯，與物多隔，不能留心寒素，衆頗謂爲刻薄。
manualTranslations.literal: however, because his family had long been honored and prominent, he was much removed from others and could not keep the poor and humble in mind; many people called him rather harsh.

manualTranslations.zh: 復遷左僕射，以母憂去官。
manualTranslations.literal: He was again transferred, this time to Left Vice Director, but left office for mourning his mother.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was again transferred, this time to Left Vice Director, but left office for mourning his mother.

manualTranslations.zh: 起爲雲麾將軍、吳郡太守。
manualTranslations.literal: He was recalled as Cloud Banner General and administrator of Wu Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was recalled as Cloud Banner General and administrator of Wu Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 還爲侍中、尚書左僕射，領國子祭酒。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He returned as Attendant-in-Ordinary and Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, concurrently Libationer of the Imperial Academy.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the winter of Putong 4, he died of a sudden illness, aged forty-seven.

localRange.text: 梁書卷第二十二列傳第十六太祖五王太祖十男。張皇后生長沙宣武王懿、永陽昭王敷、高祖、衡陽宣王暢。李太妃生桂陽簡王融。懿及融，齊永元中爲東昏所害；敷、暢，建武中卒：高祖踐阼，並追封郡王。陳太妃生臨川靖惠王宏，南平元襄王偉。吳太妃生安成康王秀，始興忠武王憺。費太妃生鄱陽忠烈王恢。

sourceRange.text: 十五年，所生母陳太妃寢疾，偉及臨川王宏侍疾，並衣不解帶。及太妃薨，毀頓過禮，水漿不入口累日，高祖每臨幸譬抑之。偉雖奉詔，而毀瘠殆不勝喪。十七年，高祖以建安土瘠，改封南平郡王，邑戶如故。遷侍中、左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。普通四年，增邑一千戶。五年，進號鎮衛大將軍。中大通元年，以本官領太子太傅。四年，遷中書令、大司馬。五年，薨，時年五十八。詔斂以袞冕，給東園秘器。又詔曰：「旌德紀功，前王令典；慎終追遠，列代通規。故侍中、中書令、大司馬南平王偉，器宇宏曠，鑒識弘簡。爰在弱齡，清風載穆，翼佐草昧，勳高樊、沔，契闊艱難，劬勞任寄。及贊務論道，弘茲袞職。奄焉薨逝，朕用震慟于厥心。宜隆寵命，式昭茂典。可贈侍中、太宰，王如故。給羽葆鼓吹一部，並班劍四十人。諡曰元襄。

context.beforeSource: 偉末年疾浸劇，不復出籓，故俸秩加焉。
context.afterSource: 」偉少好學，篤誠通恕，趨賢重士，常如不及。

manualTranslations.zh: 十五年，所生母陳太妃寢疾，偉及臨川王宏侍疾，並衣不解帶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifteenth year, his birth mother, Dowager Consort Chen, fell ill. Wei and Hong, Prince of Linchuan, attended her illness without loosening their belts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, his birth mother, Dowager Consort Chen, fell ill. Wei and Hong, Prince of Linchuan, attended her illness without loosening their belts.

manualTranslations.zh: 及太妃薨，毀頓過禮，水漿不入口累日，高祖每臨幸譬抑之。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Dowager Consort died, his grief and collapse exceeded ritual, and for several days he took neither water nor gruel; Gaozu repeatedly visited and exhorted him to restrain himself.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Dowager Consort died, his grief and collapse exceeded ritual, and for several days he took neither water nor gruel; Gaozu repeatedly visited and exhorted him to restrain himself.

manualTranslations.zh: 偉雖奉詔，而毀瘠殆不勝喪。
manualTranslations.literal: Although Wei obeyed the edict, he wasted away until he could scarcely bear the mourning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Although Wei obeyed the edict, he wasted away until he could scarcely bear the mourning.

manualTranslations.zh: 十七年，高祖以建安土瘠，改封南平郡王，邑戶如故。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventeenth year, because Jian'an's land was poor, Gaozu changed his fief to Prince of Nanping Commandery, with the household allotment as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, because Jian'an's land was poor, Gaozu changed his fief to Prince of Nanping Commandery, with the household allotment as before.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷侍中、左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to Attendant-in-Ordinary, Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, and Opening Office with Ceremonial Equal to the Three Excellencies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Attendant-in-Ordinary, Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, and Opening Office with Ceremonial Equal to the Three Excellencies.

manualTranslations.zh: 普通四年，增邑一千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In Putong 4, his fief was increased by one thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Putong 4, his fief was increased by one thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，進號鎮衛大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, his title was advanced to Grand General Who Guards and Defends.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, his title was advanced to Grand General Who Guards and Defends.

manualTranslations.zh: 中大通元年，以本官領太子太傅。
manualTranslations.literal: In Zhongdatong 1, while holding his existing office, he concurrently served as Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhongdatong 1, while holding his existing office, he concurrently served as Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，遷中書令、大司馬。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, he was transferred to Director of the Secretariat and Grand Marshal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, he was transferred to Director of the Secretariat and Grand Marshal.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，薨，時年五十八。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, he died, aged fifty-eight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, he died, aged fifty-eight.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔斂以袞冕，給東園秘器。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict ordered that he be encoffined in ceremonial robe and cap, and supplied an imperial coffin from Dongyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that he be encoffined in ceremonial robe and cap, and supplied an imperial coffin from Dongyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 又詔曰：「旌德紀功，前王令典；
manualTranslations.literal: A further edict said, "To display virtue and record achievement is a fine canon of the former kings;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A further edict said, "To display virtue and record achievement is a fine canon of the former kings;

manualTranslations.zh: 慎終追遠，列代通規。
manualTranslations.literal: to carefully attend to the end and pursue the distant past is a common rule through successive ages.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: to carefully attend to the end and pursue the distant past is a common rule through successive ages.

manualTranslations.zh: 故侍中、中書令、大司馬南平王偉，器宇宏曠，鑒識弘簡。
manualTranslations.literal: The late Wei, Prince of Nanping, Attendant-in-Ordinary, Director of the Secretariat, and Grand Marshal, had a vast and open bearing and broad, clear discernment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The late Wei, Prince of Nanping, Attendant-in-Ordinary, Director of the Secretariat, and Grand Marshal, had a vast and open bearing and broad, clear discernment.

manualTranslations.zh: 爰在弱齡，清風載穆，翼佐草昧，勳高樊、沔，契闊艱難，劬勞任寄。
manualTranslations.literal: From his youth his pure manner was serene; he assisted Us in the founding hardships, with high merit at Fan and Mian, sharing difficulties and laboring in entrusted responsibilities.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From his youth his pure manner was serene; he assisted Us in the founding hardships, with high merit at Fan and Mian, sharing difficulties and laboring in entrusted responsibilities.

manualTranslations.zh: 及贊務論道，弘茲袞職。
manualTranslations.literal: When he assisted affairs and deliberated on the Way, he enlarged this high ministerial office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he assisted affairs and deliberated on the Way, he enlarged this high ministerial office.

manualTranslations.zh: 奄焉薨逝，朕用震慟于厥心。
manualTranslations.literal: That he has suddenly died has shaken and grieved Our heart.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That he has suddenly died has shaken and grieved Our heart.

manualTranslations.zh: 宜隆寵命，式昭茂典。
manualTranslations.literal: His honors should be elevated, thereby making splendid precedent clear.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His honors should be elevated, thereby making splendid precedent clear.

manualTranslations.zh: 可贈侍中、太宰，王如故。
manualTranslations.literal: He may be posthumously granted Attendant-in-Ordinary and Grand Steward, with his princely title as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He may be posthumously granted Attendant-in-Ordinary and Grand Steward, with his princely title as before.

manualTranslations.zh: 給羽葆鼓吹一部，並班劍四十人。
manualTranslations.literal: Give him one feather-canopied corps of drummers and pipers, together with forty sword-bearing guards.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Give him one feather-canopied corps of drummers and pipers, together with forty sword-bearing guards.

manualTranslations.zh: 諡曰元襄。」
manualTranslations.literal: His posthumous title shall be Yuanxiang."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His posthumous title shall be Yuanxiang."

sourceRange.text: 十五年春，所生母陳太妃寢疾，宏與母弟南平王偉侍疾，並衣不解帶，每二宮參問，輒對使涕泣。及太妃薨，水漿不入口者五日，高祖每臨幸慰勉之。宏少而孝謹，齊之末年，避難潛伏，與太妃異處，每遣使參問起居。或謂宏曰：「逃難須密，不宜往來。」宏銜淚答曰：「乃可無我，此事不容暫廢。」尋起爲中書監，驃騎大將軍、使持節、都督如故，固辭弗許。

manualTranslations.literal: In the spring of the fifteenth year, his birth mother, Dowager Consort Chen, fell ill. Hong and his younger full brother Wei, Prince of Nanping, attended her illness without loosening their belts; whenever the two palaces sent inquiries, they answered the envoys in tears.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifteenth year, his birth mother, Dowager Consort Chen, fell ill. Hong and his younger full brother Wei, Prince of Nanping, attended her illness without loosening their belts; whenever the two palaces sent inquiries, they answered the envoys in tears.

manualTranslations.zh: 及太妃薨，水漿不入口者五日，高祖每臨幸慰勉之。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Dowager Consort died, he took neither water nor gruel for five days, and Gaozu repeatedly visited to comfort and encourage him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Dowager Consort died, he took neither water nor gruel for five days, and Gaozu repeatedly visited to comfort and encourage him.

manualTranslations.zh: 宏少而孝謹，齊之末年，避難潛伏，與太妃異處，每遣使參問起居。
manualTranslations.literal: Hong had been filial and careful from youth. In the last years of Qi, while avoiding danger and hiding, he was separated from the Dowager Consort and constantly sent messengers to inquire after her health.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hong had been filial and careful from youth. In the last years of Qi, while avoiding danger and hiding, he was separated from the Dowager Consort and constantly sent messengers to inquire after her health.

manualTranslations.zh: 或謂宏曰：「逃難須密，不宜往來。」
manualTranslations.literal: Someone told Hong, "When fleeing danger, one must keep hidden; you should not send people back and forth."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Someone told Hong, "When fleeing danger, one must keep hidden; you should not send people back and forth."

manualTranslations.zh: 宏銜淚答曰：「乃可無我，此事不容暫廢。」
manualTranslations.literal: Hong answered with tears in his eyes, "One may perhaps do without me, but this matter cannot be neglected even briefly."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hong answered with tears in his eyes, "One may perhaps do without me, but this matter cannot be neglected even briefly."

manualTranslations.zh: 尋起爲中書監，驃騎大將軍、使持節、都督如故，固辭弗許。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was recalled as Director of the Secretariat, while remaining Great General of Agile Cavalry, Envoy Holding Credentials, and commander-in-chief as before; he firmly declined, but was not permitted to refuse.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was recalled as Director of the Secretariat, while remaining Great General of Agile Cavalry, Envoy Holding Credentials, and commander-in-chief as before; he firmly declined, but was not permitted to refuse.

sourceRange.text: 世子嗣，字長胤。容貌豊偉，腰帶十圍。性驍果有膽略，倜儻不護細行，而能傾身養士，皆得其死力。範之薨也，嗣猶據晉熙，城中食盡，士乏絕，景遣任約來攻，嗣躬擐甲胄，出壘距之。時賊勢方盛，咸勸且止。嗣按劍叱之曰：「今之戰，何有退乎？此蕭嗣效命死節之秋也。」遂中流矢，卒於陣。

context.beforeSource: 範恚，發背薨，時年五十二。
context.afterSource: 始興忠武王嶦字僧達，太祖第十一子也。

manualTranslations.zh: 容貌豊偉，腰帶十圍。
manualTranslations.literal: His appearance was full and imposing, and his belt measured ten spans around.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His appearance was full and imposing, and his belt measured ten spans around.

manualTranslations.zh: 性驍果有膽略，倜儻不護細行，而能傾身養士，皆得其死力。
manualTranslations.literal: By nature he was brave and decisive, with courage and strategy. He was free-spirited and did not guard minor conduct, yet he devoted himself to nurturing officers, and all of them gave him their utmost effort to the death.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By nature he was brave and decisive, with courage and strategy. He was free-spirited and did not guard minor conduct, yet he devoted himself to nurturing officers, and all of them gave him their utmost effort to the death.

manualTranslations.zh: 範之薨也，嗣猶據晉熙，城中食盡，士乏絕，景遣任約來攻，嗣躬擐甲胄，出壘距之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Fan died, Si still held Jinxi. Food in the city was exhausted and the soldiers were utterly worn out. Jing sent Ren Yue to attack, and Si personally donned armor and went out beyond the ramparts to resist him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Fan died, Si still held Jinxi. Food in the city was exhausted and the soldiers were utterly worn out. Jing sent Ren Yue to attack, and Si personally donned armor and went out beyond the ramparts to resist him.

manualTranslations.zh: 時賊勢方盛，咸勸且止。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the rebels' momentum was strong, and everyone urged him to hold back for the moment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time the rebels' momentum was strong, and everyone urged him to hold back for the moment.

manualTranslations.zh: 嗣按劍叱之曰：「今之戰，何有退乎？
manualTranslations.literal: Si pressed his sword and rebuked them, saying, "In today's battle, how can there be retreat?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Si pressed his sword and rebuked them, saying, "In today's battle, how can there be retreat?

manualTranslations.zh: 此蕭嗣效命死節之秋也。」
manualTranslations.literal: This is the moment for Xiao Si to give his life and die for his integrity."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is the moment for Xiao Si to give his life and die for his integrity."

manualTranslations.zh: 遂中流矢，卒於陣。
manualTranslations.literal: He was then struck by a stray arrow and died in battle.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was then struck by a stray arrow and died in battle.

sourceRange.text: 高祖義師至新林，秀與諸王侯並自拔赴軍，高祖以秀爲輔國將軍。是時東昏弟晉熙王寶嵩爲冠軍將軍、南徐州刺史，鎮京口，長史范岫行府州事，遣使降，且請兵於高祖。以秀爲冠軍長史、南東海太守，鎮京口。建康平，仍爲使持節、都督南徐兗二州諸軍事、南徐州刺史，輔國將軍如故。天監元年，進號征虜將軍，封安成郡王，邑二千戶。京口自崔慧景作亂，累被兵革，民戶流散，秀招懷撫納，惠愛大行。仍值年饑，以私財贍百姓，所濟活甚多。二年，以本號徵領石頭戍事，加散騎常侍。三年，進號右將軍。五年，加領軍、中書令，給鼓吹一部。

context.afterSource: 六年，出爲使持節、都督江州諸軍事、平南將軍、江州刺史。

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖義師至新林，秀與諸王侯並自拔赴軍，高祖以秀爲輔國將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu's righteous army reached Xinlin, Xiu and the other princes and marquises extricated themselves and went to the army; Gaozu made Xiu General Who Supports the State.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu's righteous army reached Xinlin, Xiu and the other princes and marquises extricated themselves and went to the army; Gaozu made Xiu General Who Supports the State.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時東昏弟晉熙王寶嵩爲冠軍將軍、南徐州刺史，鎮京口，長史范岫行府州事，遣使降，且請兵於高祖。
manualTranslations.literal: At this time Donghun's younger brother Baosong, Prince of Jinxi, was Champion General and inspector of South Xuzhou, garrisoning Jingkou. His chief clerk Fan Xiu was acting over headquarters and provincial affairs; he sent an envoy to surrender and also requested troops from Gaozu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At this time Donghun's younger brother Baosong, Prince of Jinxi, was Champion General and inspector of South Xuzhou, garrisoning Jingkou. His chief clerk Fan Xiu was acting over headquarters and provincial affairs; he sent an envoy to surrender and also requested troops from Gaozu.

manualTranslations.zh: 以秀爲冠軍長史、南東海太守，鎮京口。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiu was made chief clerk to the Champion General and administrator of South Donghai, and garrisoned Jingkou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiu was made chief clerk to the Champion General and administrator of South Donghai, and garrisoned Jingkou.

manualTranslations.zh: 建康平，仍爲使持節、都督南徐兗二州諸軍事、南徐州刺史，輔國將軍如故。
manualTranslations.literal: After Jiankang was pacified, he remained Envoy Holding Credentials, commander of military affairs in South Xuzhou and Yanzhou, and inspector of South Xuzhou, while continuing as General Who Supports the State.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Jiankang was pacified, he remained Envoy Holding Credentials, commander of military affairs in South Xuzhou and Yanzhou, and inspector of South Xuzhou, while continuing as General Who Supports the State.

manualTranslations.zh: 天監元年，進號征虜將軍，封安成郡王，邑二千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianjian 1, his title was advanced to General Who Subdues Captives, and he was enfeoffed as Prince of Ancheng Commandery with a fief of two thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjian 1, his title was advanced to General Who Subdues Captives, and he was enfeoffed as Prince of Ancheng Commandery with a fief of two thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 京口自崔慧景作亂，累被兵革，民戶流散，秀招懷撫納，惠愛大行。
manualTranslations.literal: Since Cui Huijing's rebellion, Jingkou had repeatedly suffered warfare and its households had scattered. Xiu summoned them back, comforted them, and showed them benevolent care, and his kindness was widely practiced.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since Cui Huijing's rebellion, Jingkou had repeatedly suffered warfare and its households had scattered. Xiu summoned them back, comforted them, and showed them benevolent care, and his kindness was widely practiced.

manualTranslations.zh: 仍值年饑，以私財贍百姓，所濟活甚多。
manualTranslations.literal: When the year also turned famine-stricken, he used his private wealth to support the people, saving many lives.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the year also turned famine-stricken, he used his private wealth to support the people, saving many lives.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，以本號徵領石頭戍事，加散騎常侍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, he was summoned with his original title to oversee the Shitou garrison and was additionally made Regular Attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, he was summoned with his original title to oversee the Shitou garrison and was additionally made Regular Attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，進號右將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, his title was advanced to Right General.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, his title was advanced to Right General.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，加領軍、中書令，給鼓吹一部。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, he was additionally made Commander of the Army and Director of the Secretariat, and was given one corps of drummers and pipers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, he was additionally made Commander of the Army and Director of the Secretariat, and was given one corps of drummers and pipers.

sourceRange.text: 桂陽嗣王象字世翼，長沙宣武王第九子也。初，叔父融仕齊至太子洗馬。永元中，宣武之難，融遇害。高祖平京邑，贈給事黃門侍郎。天監元年，加散騎常侍、撫軍大將軍，封桂陽郡王。諡曰簡。無子，乃詔象爲嗣，襲封爵。

manualTranslations.literal: Xiang, Heir Prince of Guiyang, styled Shiyi, was the ninth son of Prince Xuanwu of Changsha.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiang, Heir Prince of Guiyang, styled Shiyi, was the ninth son of Prince Xuanwu of Changsha.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖平京邑，贈給事黃門侍郎。

manualTranslations.zh: 天監元年，加散騎常侍、撫軍大將軍，封桂陽郡王。
