manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjian 1, he was additionally made Regular Attendant and Great General Who Pacifies the Army, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Guiyang Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 諡曰簡。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Jian.

manualTranslations.zh: 無子，乃詔象爲嗣，襲封爵。
manualTranslations.literal: He had no son, so an edict made Xiang his heir, and Xiang inherited the noble title.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He had no son, so an edict made Xiang his heir, and Xiang inherited the noble title.

sourceRange.text: 永陽嗣王伯游字士仁，高祖次兄敷之子。敷字仲達，解褐齊後將軍、征虜行參軍，輔太子舍人，洗馬，遷丹陽尹丞。入爲太子中舍人，除建威將軍、隨郡內史。招懷遠近，黎庶安之，以爲前後之政莫之及也。進號寧朔將軍，徵爲廬陵王諮議參軍。建武四年，薨。高祖即位，追贈侍中、司空，封永陽郡王，諡曰昭。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fu, styled Zhongda, began office as acting staff officer to Qi's General of the Rear and General Who Subdues Captives, then served as assistant crown prince attendant and Groom, and was transferred to assistant Intendant of Danyang.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He entered court as central household attendant to the crown prince and was appointed General Who Establishes Might and Interior Minister of Sui Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 招懷遠近，黎庶安之，以爲前後之政莫之及也。
manualTranslations.literal: He summoned and comforted people far and near, and the common people were at peace under him; they believed that no administration before or after matched his.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He summoned and comforted people far and near, and the common people were at peace under him; they believed that no administration before or after matched his.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: His title was advanced to General Who Pacifies the North, and he was summoned to be advisory army aide to the Prince of Luling.

manualTranslations.zh: 建武四年，薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In Jianwu 4, he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Jianwu 4, he died.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖即位，追贈侍中、司空，封永陽郡王，諡曰昭。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne, Fu was posthumously granted the offices of Attendant-in-Ordinary and Minister of Works, enfeoffed as Prince of Yongyang Commandery, and given the posthumous title Zhao.

sourceRange.text: 藻字靖藝，元王弟也。少立名行，志操清潔。齊永元初，釋褐著作佐郎。天監元年，封西昌縣侯，食邑五百戶。出爲持節、都督益、寧二州諸軍事、冠軍將軍、益州刺史。時天下草創，邊徼未安，州民焦僧護聚衆數萬，據郫、繁作亂。藻年未弱冠，集僚佐議，欲自擊之。或陳不可，藻大怒，斬于階側。乃乘平肩輿，巡行賊壘。賊弓亂射，矢下如雨，從者舉楯禦箭，又命除之，由是人心大安。賊乃夜遁，藻命騎追之，斬首數千級，遂平之。進號信威將軍，九年，徵爲太子中庶子。十年，爲左驍騎將軍、領南琅邪太守。入爲侍中。

context.beforeSource: 子慎嗣。
context.afterSource: 藻性謙退，不求聞達。

manualTranslations.zh: 藻字靖藝，元王弟也。
manualTranslations.literal: Zao, styled Jingyi, was the younger brother of Prince Yuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zao, styled Jingyi, was the younger brother of Prince Yuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 少立名行，志操清潔。
manualTranslations.literal: From youth he established a reputation for conduct, and his aspirations and integrity were pure.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth he established a reputation for conduct, and his aspirations and integrity were pure.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊永元初，釋褐著作佐郎。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Qi's Yongyuan era, he entered office as Assistant Compiler.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Qi's Yongyuan era, he entered office as Assistant Compiler.

manualTranslations.zh: 天監元年，封西昌縣侯，食邑五百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianjian 1, he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xichang county, with a fief of five hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjian 1, he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xichang county, with a fief of five hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 出爲持節、都督益、寧二州諸軍事、冠軍將軍、益州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out as Envoy Holding Credentials, commander of military affairs in Yi and Ning provinces, Champion General, and inspector of Yizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He went out as Envoy Holding Credentials, commander of military affairs in Yi and Ning provinces, Champion General, and inspector of Yizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 時天下草創，邊徼未安，州民焦僧護聚衆數萬，據郫、繁作亂。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the realm had only just been founded and the border regions were not yet settled. A provincial man, Jiao Senghu, gathered tens of thousands, occupied Pi and Fan, and rebelled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time the realm had only just been founded and the border regions were not yet settled. A provincial man, Jiao Senghu, gathered tens of thousands, occupied Pi and Fan, and rebelled.

manualTranslations.zh: 藻年未弱冠，集僚佐議，欲自擊之。
manualTranslations.literal: Zao was not yet twenty. He gathered his aides to deliberate and wanted to attack the rebels himself.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zao was not yet twenty. He gathered his aides to deliberate and wanted to attack the rebels himself.

manualTranslations.zh: 或陳不可，藻大怒，斬于階側。
manualTranslations.literal: Someone stated that this was impossible; Zao became furious and had him beheaded beside the steps.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Someone stated that this was impossible; Zao became furious and had him beheaded beside the steps.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃乘平肩輿，巡行賊壘。
manualTranslations.literal: He then rode a level-shouldered litter and made a circuit of the rebel camps.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then rode a level-shouldered litter and made a circuit of the rebel camps.

manualTranslations.zh: 賊弓亂射，矢下如雨，從者舉楯禦箭，又命除之，由是人心大安。
manualTranslations.literal: The rebels loosed arrows wildly, and shafts fell like rain. His attendants raised shields against the arrows, but he ordered the shields removed, and the people's hearts were greatly calmed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The rebels loosed arrows wildly, and shafts fell like rain. His attendants raised shields against the arrows, but he ordered the shields removed, and the people's hearts were greatly calmed.

manualTranslations.zh: 賊乃夜遁，藻命騎追之，斬首數千級，遂平之。
manualTranslations.literal: The rebels then fled by night. Zao ordered cavalry to pursue them, took several thousand heads, and pacified them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The rebels then fled by night. Zao ordered cavalry to pursue them, took several thousand heads, and pacified them.

manualTranslations.zh: 進號信威將軍，九年，徵爲太子中庶子。
manualTranslations.literal: His title was advanced to General Who Inspires Trusting Awe, and in the ninth year he was summoned to be Household Attendant to the Crown Prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His title was advanced to General Who Inspires Trusting Awe, and in the ninth year he was summoned to be Household Attendant to the Crown Prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 十年，爲左驍騎將軍、領南琅邪太守。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth year, he became Left General of Agile Cavalry and acting administrator of South Langye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, he became Left General of Agile Cavalry and acting administrator of South Langye.

manualTranslations.zh: 入爲侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: He entered court as Attendant-in-Ordinary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He entered court as Attendant-in-Ordinary.

sourceRange.text: 昂字子明，景第三弟也。天監初，累遷司徒右長史，出爲輕車將軍、監南兗州。初，兄景再爲南兗，德惠在人，及昂來代，時人方之馮氏。徵爲琅邪、彭城二郡太守，軍號如先。復以輕車將軍出爲廣州刺史。普通二年，爲散騎常侍、信威將軍。四年，轉散騎侍郎、中領軍、太子中庶子，出爲吳興太守。大通二年，徵爲仁威將軍、衛尉卿，尋爲侍中，兼領軍將軍。中大通元年，爲領軍將軍。二年，封湘陰縣侯，邑一千戶。出爲江州刺史。大同元年，卒，時年五十三。諡曰恭。

context.afterSource: 昱字子真，景第四弟也。

manualTranslations.zh: 天監初，累遷司徒右長史，出爲輕車將軍、監南兗州。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Tianjian, he rose through successive posts to right chief clerk to the Minister over the Masses, then went out as Light Chariot General and supervisor of South Yanzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianjian, he rose through successive posts to right chief clerk to the Minister over the Masses, then went out as Light Chariot General and supervisor of South Yanzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，兄景再爲南兗，德惠在人，及昂來代，時人方之馮氏。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, his elder brother Jing had twice governed South Yanzhou, and his kindness and benefits remained among the people. When Ang came to replace him, people of the time compared them to the Feng clan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, his elder brother Jing had twice governed South Yanzhou, and his kindness and benefits remained among the people. When Ang came to replace him, people of the time compared them to the Feng clan.

manualTranslations.zh: 徵爲琅邪、彭城二郡太守，軍號如先。
manualTranslations.literal: He was summoned to be administrator of Langye and Pengcheng commanderies, with his military title as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was summoned to be administrator of Langye and Pengcheng commanderies, with his military title as before.

manualTranslations.zh: 復以輕車將軍出爲廣州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He again went out as Light Chariot General and inspector of Guangzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He again went out as Light Chariot General and inspector of Guangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 普通二年，爲散騎常侍、信威將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In Putong 2, he became Regular Attendant and General Who Inspires Trusting Awe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Putong 2, he became Regular Attendant and General Who Inspires Trusting Awe.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，轉散騎侍郎、中領軍、太子中庶子，出爲吳興太守。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, he was transferred to Scattered Cavalry Gentleman, Commander of the Central Army, and Household Attendant to the Crown Prince, then went out as administrator of Wuxing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, he was transferred to Scattered Cavalry Gentleman, Commander of the Central Army, and Household Attendant to the Crown Prince, then went out as administrator of Wuxing.

manualTranslations.zh: 大通二年，徵爲仁威將軍、衛尉卿，尋爲侍中，兼領軍將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In Datong 2, he was summoned as General of Benevolent Awe and Commandant of the Guards, and soon became Attendant-in-Ordinary, concurrently Commander of the Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong 2, he was summoned as General of Benevolent Awe and Commandant of the Guards, and soon became Attendant-in-Ordinary, concurrently Commander of the Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 中大通元年，爲領軍將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In Zhongdatong 1, he became Commander of the Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhongdatong 1, he became Commander of the Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，封湘陰縣侯，邑一千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xiangyin county, with a fief of one thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xiangyin county, with a fief of one thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 出爲江州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out as inspector of Jiangzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He went out as inspector of Jiangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 大同元年，卒，時年五十三。
manualTranslations.literal: In Datong 1, he died, aged fifty-three.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong 1, he died, aged fifty-three.

manualTranslations.zh: 諡曰恭。
manualTranslations.literal: His posthumous title was Gong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Gong.

sourceRange.text: 」中大通三年，又以疾自陳，移授特進、右光祿大夫、侍中、中衛將軍，置佐史，餘如故。增親信四十人。兩宮參問，冠蓋結轍；服膳醫藥，皆資天府。有敕每欲臨幸，勉以拜伏有虧，頻啓停出，詔許之，遂停輿駕。大同元年，卒，時年七十。高祖聞而流涕，卽日車駕臨殯，乃詔贈特進、右光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，餘並如故。給東園秘器，朝服一具，衣一襲。贈錢二十萬，布百匹。皇太子亦舉哀朝堂。諡曰簡肅公。

context.beforeSource: 諸賢旣貽格言，喻以大理，卽日輟哀，命駕修職事焉。
context.afterSource: 勉善屬文，勤著述，雖當機務，下筆不休。

manualTranslations.zh: 兩宮參問，冠蓋結轍；

manualTranslations.idiomatic: The two palaces sent inquiries, and the tracks of capped carriages joined one another;

manualTranslations.zh: 有敕每欲臨幸，勉以拜伏有虧，頻啓停出，詔許之，遂停輿駕。
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever there was an edict intending to visit him, Mian, because he could not properly bow and prostrate himself, repeatedly petitioned that the outing be stopped. The edict permitted it, and the imperial carriage was therefore halted.

manualTranslations.zh: 大同元年，卒，時年七十。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong 1, he died, aged seventy.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖聞而流涕，卽日車駕臨殯，乃詔贈特進、右光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，餘並如故。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu heard, he shed tears, and that same day the imperial carriage visited the bier. manualTranslations.zh: 給東園秘器，朝服一具，衣一襲。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was supplied an imperial coffin from Dongyuan, one set of court robes, and one suit of clothes.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈錢二十萬，布百匹。

manualTranslations.zh: 皇太子亦舉哀朝堂。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: The crown prince also held mourning for him in the court hall.

manualTranslations.zh: 諡曰簡肅公。

sourceRange.text: 杲少好學，工書畫，舅張融有高名，杲風韻舉動，頗類於融，時稱之曰：「無對日下，惟舅與甥。」起家齊中軍法曹行參軍，太子舍人，衛軍王儉主簿。遷尚書殿中曹郎，拜日，八座丞郎並到上省交禮，而杲至晚，不及時刻，坐免官。久之，以爲司徒竟陵王外兵參軍，遷征虜宜都王功曹史，驃騎晉安王諮議參軍，司徒從事中郎。梁臺建，以爲驃騎記室參軍，遷相國西曹掾。天監元年，除撫軍長史，母憂去職。服闋，拜建威將軍、中軍臨川王諮議參軍，尋遷黃門侍郎，右軍安成王長史。五年，遷御史中丞。

context.afterSource: 杲性婞直，無所顧望。

manualTranslations.zh: 杲少好學，工書畫，舅張融有高名，杲風韻舉動，頗類於融，時稱之曰：「無對日下，惟舅與甥。」
manualTranslations.literal: Gao loved learning from youth and was skilled at calligraphy and painting. His maternal uncle Zhang Rong had a great reputation, and Gao's style, bearing, and movements much resembled Rong, so people of the time said, "There are no equals under the sun, only uncle and nephew."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gao loved learning from youth and was skilled at calligraphy and painting. His maternal uncle Zhang Rong had a great reputation, and Gao's style, bearing, and movements much resembled Rong, so people of the time said, "There are no equals under the sun, only uncle and nephew."

manualTranslations.zh: 起家齊中軍法曹行參軍，太子舍人，衛軍王儉主簿。
manualTranslations.literal: He began office as acting law bureau staff officer in Qi's Central Army, then served as crown prince attendant and chief clerk to Wang Jian, General of the Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He began office as acting law bureau staff officer in Qi's Central Army, then served as crown prince attendant and chief clerk to Wang Jian, General of the Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷尚書殿中曹郎，拜日，八座丞郎並到上省交禮，而杲至晚，不及時刻，坐免官。
manualTranslations.literal: He was promoted to gentleman of the Palace Section in the Department of State Affairs. On the day of his appointment, the Eight Seats, assistant directors, and gentlemen all came to the upper office to exchange courtesies, but Gao arrived late and missed the appointed time, and for this he was dismissed from office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was promoted to gentleman of the Palace Section in the Department of State Affairs. On the day of his appointment, the Eight Seats, assistant directors, and gentlemen all came to the upper office to exchange courtesies, but Gao arrived late and missed the appointed time, and for this he was dismissed from office.

manualTranslations.zh: 久之，以爲司徒竟陵王外兵參軍，遷征虜宜都王功曹史，驃騎晉安王諮議參軍，司徒從事中郎。
manualTranslations.literal: After a long while, he was made external military aide to the Prince of Jingling, Minister over the Masses, then transferred to merit officer for the Prince of Yidu, General Who Subdues Captives, advisory army aide to the Prince of Jin'an, General of Agile Cavalry, and attendant gentleman to the Minister over the Masses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After a long while, he was made external military aide to the Prince of Jingling, Minister over the Masses, then transferred to merit officer for the Prince of Yidu, General Who Subdues Captives, advisory army aide to the Prince of Jin'an, General of Agile Cavalry, and attendant gentleman to the Minister over the Masses.

manualTranslations.zh: 梁臺建，以爲驃騎記室參軍，遷相國西曹掾。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Liang administration was established, he was made secretary aide to the General of Agile Cavalry and transferred to western bureau clerk to the Chancellor of State.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Liang administration was established, he was made secretary aide to the General of Agile Cavalry and transferred to western bureau clerk to the Chancellor of State.

manualTranslations.zh: 天監元年，除撫軍長史，母憂去職。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianjian 1, he was appointed chief clerk to the General Who Pacifies the Army, then left office to mourn his mother.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjian 1, he was appointed chief clerk to the General Who Pacifies the Army, then left office to mourn his mother.

manualTranslations.zh: 服闋，拜建威將軍、中軍臨川王諮議參軍，尋遷黃門侍郎，右軍安成王長史。
manualTranslations.literal: When mourning ended, he was appointed General Who Establishes Might and advisory army aide to the Prince of Linchuan in the Central Army; soon he was transferred to Yellow Gate Gentleman and chief clerk to the Prince of Ancheng in the Right Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When mourning ended, he was appointed General Who Establishes Might and advisory army aide to the Prince of Linchuan in the Central Army; soon he was transferred to Yellow Gate Gentleman and chief clerk to the Prince of Ancheng in the Right Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，遷御史中丞。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, he was promoted to Palace Assistant Censor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, he was promoted to Palace Assistant Censor.

manualTranslations.literal: When Donghun first succeeded to the throne, the court debated that there was no precedent for presenting himself in the ancestral temple. Chen argued on the basis of the Zhou hymns "Liewen" and "Minyu," both of which were precedents for going to court in the temple at accession, and this was followed.

sourceRange.text: 韋放字元直，車騎將軍叡之子。初爲齊晉安王寧朔迎主簿，高祖臨雍州，又召爲主簿。放身長七尺七寸，腰帶八圍，容貌甚偉。天監元年，爲盱眙太守，還除通直郎，尋爲輕車晉安王中兵參軍，遷鎮右始興王諮議參軍，以父憂去職。服闋，襲封永昌縣侯，出爲輕車南平王長史、襄陽太守。轉假節、明威將軍、竟陵太守。在郡和理，爲吏民所稱。

context.beforeSource: 遷爲平西湘東王司馬、新興、永寧二郡太守，卒官。
context.afterSource: 六年，大舉北伐，以放爲貞威將軍，與胡龍牙會曹仲宗進軍。

sourceRange.text: 夔字季龍，亶弟也。起家齊南康王府行參軍。中興初，遷司徒屬。天監元年，爲太子洗馬，中舍人，中書郎。丁父憂，服闋，除大匠卿，知造太極殿事。普通元年，爲邵陵王信威長史，行府國事。其年，出爲假節、征遠將軍，隨機北討，還除給事黃門侍郎。二年，副裴邃討義州，平之。三年，代兄亶爲吳興太守，尋遷假節、征遠將軍、西陽、武昌二郡太守。七年，徵爲衛尉，未拜，改授持節、督司州諸軍事、信武將軍、司州刺史，領安陸太守。

context.beforeSource: 太清中，侯景入寇，誼與弟損帥部曲入城，並卒圍內。
context.afterSource: 八年，敕夔帥壯武將軍裴之禮、直閤將軍任思祖出義陽道，攻平靜、穆陵、陰山三關，克之。

sourceRange.text: 之橫字如岳，之高第十三弟也。少好賓遊，重氣俠，不事產業。之高以其縱誕，乃爲狹被蔬食以激厲之。之橫歎曰：「大丈夫富貴，必作百幅被。」遂與僮屬數百人，於芍陂大營田墅，遂致殷積。太宗在東宮，聞而要之，以爲河東王常侍、直殿主帥，遷直閤將軍。侯景亂，出爲貞威將軍，隸鄱陽王範討景。景濟江，仍與範長子嗣入援。連營度淮，據東城。京都陷，退還合肥，與範溯流赴湓城。景遣任約上逼晉熙，範令之橫下援，未及至，範薨，之橫乃還。

manualTranslations.literal: Zhiheng, styled Ruyue, was Zhigao's thirteenth younger brother.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhiheng, styled Ruyue, was Zhigao's thirteenth younger brother.

manualTranslations.zh: 少好賓遊，重氣俠，不事產業。
manualTranslations.literal: From youth he loved guests and roaming, valued spirit and chivalry, and did not attend to property.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth he loved guests and roaming, valued spirit and chivalry, and did not attend to property.

manualTranslations.zh: 之高以其縱誕，乃爲狹被蔬食以激厲之。
manualTranslations.literal: Because he was unrestrained and extravagant, Zhigao gave him a narrow quilt and plain vegetable food to spur him on.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because he was unrestrained and extravagant, Zhigao gave him a narrow quilt and plain vegetable food to spur him on.

manualTranslations.zh: 之橫歎曰：「大丈夫富貴，必作百幅被。」
manualTranslations.literal: Zhiheng sighed, "When a great man becomes rich and honored, he must make a hundred-width quilt."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhiheng sighed, "When a great man becomes rich and honored, he must make a hundred-width quilt."

manualTranslations.zh: 遂與僮屬數百人，於芍陂大營田墅，遂致殷積。
manualTranslations.literal: He then took several hundred servants and dependents and established large fields and estates at Shaopi, eventually amassing abundant wealth.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then took several hundred servants and dependents and established large fields and estates at Shaopi, eventually amassing abundant wealth.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗在東宮，聞而要之，以爲河東王常侍、直殿主帥，遷直閤將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Taizong was in the Eastern Palace, he heard of this and summoned him, making him attendant to the Prince of Hedong and commander on palace duty; Zhiheng was then promoted to Direct-Hall General.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Taizong was in the Eastern Palace, he heard of this and summoned him, making him attendant to the Prince of Hedong and commander on palace duty; Zhiheng was then promoted to Direct-Hall General.

manualTranslations.zh: 侯景亂，出爲貞威將軍，隸鄱陽王範討景。
manualTranslations.literal: During Hou Jing's rebellion, he went out as General of Firm Awe and was attached to Fan, Prince of Poyang, in the campaign against Jing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Hou Jing's rebellion, he went out as General of Firm Awe and was attached to Fan, Prince of Poyang, in the campaign against Jing.

manualTranslations.zh: 景濟江，仍與範長子嗣入援。
manualTranslations.literal: When Jing crossed the Yangtze, Zhiheng entered to give aid together with Fan's eldest son Si.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Jing crossed the Yangtze, Zhiheng entered to give aid together with Fan's eldest son Si.

manualTranslations.zh: 連營度淮，據東城。
manualTranslations.literal: They linked camps, crossed the Huai, and occupied Dongcheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They linked camps, crossed the Huai, and occupied Dongcheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 京都陷，退還合肥，與範溯流赴湓城。
manualTranslations.literal: When the capital fell, he withdrew back to Hefei and went upstream with Fan to Pencheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the capital fell, he withdrew back to Hefei and went upstream with Fan to Pencheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 景遣任約上逼晉熙，範令之橫下援，未及至，範薨，之橫乃還。
manualTranslations.literal: Jing sent Ren Yue upriver to press Jinxi. Fan ordered Zhiheng to go downriver to its aid, but before he arrived Fan died, and Zhiheng returned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jing sent Ren Yue upriver to press Jinxi. Fan ordered Zhiheng to go downriver to its aid, but before he arrived Fan died, and Zhiheng returned.

sourceRange.text: 欽幼而果決，篸捷過人。隨父北征，授東宮直閤。大通元年，攻魏蕭城，拔之。仍破彭城別將郊仲，進攻擬山城，破其大都督劉屬衆二十萬。進攻籠城，獲馬千餘匹。又破其大將柴集及襄城太守高宣、別將范思念、鄭承宗等。仍攻厥固、張龍、子城，未拔，魏彭城守將楊目遣子孝邕率輕兵來援，欽逆擊走之。又破譙州刺史劉海游，還拔厥固，收其家口。楊目又遣都督范思念、別將曹龍牙數萬衆來援，欽與戰，于陣斬龍牙，傳首京師。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He accompanied his father on the northern campaign and was appointed Direct Guard of the Eastern Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 大通元年，攻魏蕭城，拔之。
manualTranslations.literal: In Datong 1, he attacked Wei's Xiao city and took it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong 1, he attacked Wei's Xiao city and took it.

manualTranslations.zh: 仍破彭城別將郊仲，進攻擬山城，破其大都督劉屬衆二十萬。
manualTranslations.literal: He then defeated Jiao Zhong, a detached general from Pengcheng, advanced to attack Nishan city, and defeated the two hundred thousand troops of its grand commander Liu Shu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then defeated Jiao Zhong, a detached general from Pengcheng, advanced to attack Nishan city, and defeated the two hundred thousand troops of its grand commander Liu Shu.

manualTranslations.zh: 進攻籠城，獲馬千餘匹。
manualTranslations.literal: He advanced to attack Longcheng and captured more than one thousand horses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He advanced to attack Longcheng and captured more than one thousand horses.

manualTranslations.zh: 又破其大將柴集及襄城太守高宣、別將范思念、鄭承宗等。
manualTranslations.literal: He also defeated their great general Chai Ji, Gao Xuan, administrator of Xiangcheng, and the detached generals Fan Sinian, Zheng Chengzong, and others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also defeated their great general Chai Ji, Gao Xuan, administrator of Xiangcheng, and the detached generals Fan Sinian, Zheng Chengzong, and others.

manualTranslations.zh: 仍攻厥固、張龍、子城，未拔，魏彭城守將楊目遣子孝邕率輕兵來援，欽逆擊走之。
manualTranslations.literal: He then attacked Juegu, Zhanglong, and Zicheng, but had not yet taken them when Yang Mu, Wei's defending general at Pengcheng, sent his son Xiaoyong with light troops to reinforce them; Qin met him and drove him off.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then attacked Juegu, Zhanglong, and Zicheng, but had not yet taken them when Yang Mu, Wei's defending general at Pengcheng, sent his son Xiaoyong with light troops to reinforce them; Qin met him and drove him off.

manualTranslations.zh: 又破譙州刺史劉海游，還拔厥固，收其家口。
manualTranslations.literal: He also defeated Liu Haiyou, Wei's inspector of Qiaozhou, returned to take Juegu, and seized his household.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also defeated Liu Haiyou, Wei's inspector of Qiaozhou, returned to take Juegu, and seized his household.

manualTranslations.zh: 楊目又遣都督范思念、別將曹龍牙數萬衆來援，欽與戰，于陣斬龍牙，傳首京師。
manualTranslations.literal: Yang Mu again sent commander Fan Sinian and detached general Cao Longya with tens of thousands to reinforce the city. Qin fought them, beheaded Longya in battle, and sent his head to the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yang Mu again sent commander Fan Sinian and detached general Cao Longya with tens of thousands to reinforce the city. Qin fought them, beheaded Longya in battle, and sent his head to the capital.

sourceRange.text: 還除太子僕，累遷招遠將軍、司徒右長史、揚州別駕。率雖歷居職務，未嘗留心簿領，及爲別駕奏事，高祖覽牒問之，並無對，但奉答云「事在牒中」。高祖不悅。俄遷太子家令，與中庶子陸倕、僕射劉孝綽對掌東宮管記，遷黃門侍郎。出爲新安太守，秩滿還都，未至，丁所生母憂。大通元年，服未闋，卒，時年五十三。昭明太子遣使贈賻，與晉安王綱令曰：「近張新安又致故。其人才筆弘雅，亦足嗟惜。隨弟府朝，東西日久，尤當傷懷也。比人物零落，特可潸慨，屬有今信，乃復及之。

context.beforeSource: 率在府十年，恩禮甚篤。
context.afterSource: 」率嗜酒，事事寬恕，于家務尤忘懷。

manualTranslations.literal: On returning, Shu was appointed Chamberlain of the Crown Prince's Stables and rose successively to General Who Summons the Distant, right chief clerk to the Minister over the Masses, and aide-de-camp of Yangzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On returning, Shu was appointed Chamberlain of the Crown Prince's Stables and rose successively to General Who Summons the Distant, right chief clerk to the Minister over the Masses, and aide-de-camp of Yangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 率雖歷居職務，未嘗留心簿領，及爲別駕奏事，高祖覽牒問之，並無對，但奉答云「事在牒中」。
manualTranslations.literal: Although Shu held a series of offices, he never put his mind to registers and documents. When, as aide-de-camp, he reported matters, Gaozu read the papers and questioned him, but Shu had no answers and merely replied, "The matter is in the papers."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Although Shu held a series of offices, he never put his mind to registers and documents. When, as aide-de-camp, he reported matters, Gaozu read the papers and questioned him, but Shu had no answers and merely replied, "The matter is in the papers."

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖不悅。
manualTranslations.literal: Gaozu was displeased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozu was displeased.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄遷太子家令，與中庶子陸倕、僕射劉孝綽對掌東宮管記，遷黃門侍郎。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Household Supervisor to the Crown Prince, and together with Household Attendant Lu Chui and Vice Director Liu Xiaochuo he jointly managed the Eastern Palace records; he was then transferred to Yellow Gate Gentleman.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to Household Supervisor to the Crown Prince, and together with Household Attendant Lu Chui and Vice Director Liu Xiaochuo he jointly managed the Eastern Palace records; he was then transferred to Yellow Gate Gentleman.

manualTranslations.zh: 出爲新安太守，秩滿還都，未至，丁所生母憂。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out as administrator of Xin'an. When his term ended he returned toward the capital, but before he arrived his birth mother died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He went out as administrator of Xin'an. When his term ended he returned toward the capital, but before he arrived his birth mother died.

manualTranslations.zh: 大通元年，服未闋，卒，時年五十三。
manualTranslations.literal: In Datong 1, before his mourning had ended, he died, aged fifty-three.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong 1, before his mourning had ended, he died, aged fifty-three.

manualTranslations.zh: 昭明太子遣使贈賻，與晉安王綱令曰：「近張新安又致故。
manualTranslations.literal: Crown Prince Zhaoming sent an envoy with funeral gifts and wrote an order to Gang, Prince of Jin'an, saying, "Recently Zhang of Xin'an has also passed away.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Zhaoming sent an envoy with funeral gifts and wrote an order to Gang, Prince of Jin'an, saying, "Recently Zhang of Xin'an has also passed away.

manualTranslations.zh: 其人才筆弘雅，亦足嗟惜。
manualTranslations.literal: His talent and writing were broad and elegant, and he too is worthy of lament.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His talent and writing were broad and elegant, and he too is worthy of lament.

manualTranslations.zh: 隨弟府朝，東西日久，尤當傷懷也。
manualTranslations.literal: He served in my younger brother's princely establishment and court, east and west, for a long time, so this must be especially painful to the heart.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He served in my younger brother's princely establishment and court, east and west, for a long time, so this must be especially painful to the heart.

manualTranslations.zh: 比人物零落，特可潸慨，屬有今信，乃復及之。」
manualTranslations.literal: Recently worthy men have been falling away; it particularly brings tears and sighs. Since this news has now arrived, I mention it again."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Recently worthy men have been falling away; it particularly brings tears and sighs. Since this news has now arrived, I mention it again."

manualTranslations.zh: 張緬字元長，車騎將軍弘策子也。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhang Mian, styled Yuanchang, was the son of Hongce, General of Chariots and Cavalry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhang Mian, styled Yuanchang, was the son of Hongce, General of Chariots and Cavalry.

manualTranslations.zh: 年數歲，外祖中山劉仲德異之，嘗曰：「此兒非常器，爲張氏寶也。」
manualTranslations.literal: When he was only a few years old, his maternal grandfather Liu Zhongde of Zhongshan saw something extraordinary in him and once said, "This child is no ordinary vessel; he is a treasure of the Zhang clan."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he was only a few years old, his maternal grandfather Liu Zhongde of Zhongshan saw something extraordinary in him and once said, "This child is no ordinary vessel; he is a treasure of the Zhang clan."

manualTranslations.zh: 齊永元末，義師起，弘策從高祖入伐，留緬襄陽，年始十歲，每聞軍有勝負，憂喜形於顏色。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of Qi's Yongyuan era, when the righteous army rose, Hongce followed Gaozu on the invasion and left Mian in Xiangyang. Mian was only ten, yet whenever he heard that the army had won or lost, worry or joy showed on his face.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the end of Qi's Yongyuan era, when the righteous army rose, Hongce followed Gaozu on the invasion and left Mian in Xiangyang. Mian was only ten, yet whenever he heard that the army had won or lost, worry or joy showed on his face.

manualTranslations.zh: 天監元年，弘策任衛尉卿，爲妖賊所害，緬痛父之酷，喪過於禮，高祖遣戒喻之。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianjian 1, while Hongce was serving as Commandant of the Guards, he was killed by rebels. Mian grieved over his father's cruel death and mourned beyond the rites, so Gaozu sent someone to admonish and counsel him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjian 1, while Hongce was serving as Commandant of the Guards, he was killed by rebels. Mian grieved over his father's cruel death and mourned beyond the rites, so Gaozu sent someone to admonish and counsel him.

manualTranslations.zh: 服闋，襲洮陽縣侯，召補國子生。
manualTranslations.literal: When mourning ended, he inherited the title Marquis of Taoyang county and was summoned to fill a place as student of the Imperial Academy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When mourning ended, he inherited the title Marquis of Taoyang county and was summoned to fill a place as student of the Imperial Academy.

sourceRange.text: 子雲性沈靜，不樂仕進。年三十，方起家爲秘書郎。遷太子舍人，撰《東宮新記》，奏之，敕賜束帛。累遷北中郎外兵參軍，晉安王文學，司徒主簿，丹陽尹丞。時湘東王爲京尹，深相賞好，如布衣之交。遷北中郎廬陵王諮議參軍，兼尚書左丞。大通元年，除黃門郎，俄遷輕車將軍，兼司徒左長史。二年，入爲吏部。三年，遷長兼侍中。中大通元年，轉太府卿。三年，出爲貞威將軍、臨川內史。在郡以和理稱，民吏悅之。還除散騎常侍，俄復爲侍中。大同二年，遷員外散騎常侍、國子祭酒，領南徐州大中正。頃之，復爲侍中，祭酒、中正如故。

sourceRange.text: 徵爲太府卿，俄授都官尚書，頃之，領太子中庶子。普通七年，揚州刺史臨川王宏薨，高祖與羣臣議代王居州任者久之，于時貴戚王公，咸望遷授，高祖曰：「朕已得人。孔休源才識通敏，實應此選。」乃授宣惠將軍、監揚州。休源初爲臨川王行佐，及王薨而管州任，時論榮之。而神州都會，簿領殷繁，休源割斷如流，傍無私謁。中大通二年，加授金紫光祿大夫，監揚州如故。累表陳讓，優詔不許。在州晝決辭訟，夜覽墳籍。每車駕巡幸，常以軍國事委之。

context.beforeSource: 其見敬如此。

manualTranslations.literal: He was summoned as Chamberlain of the Imperial Treasury, soon appointed Minister of Justice, and before long concurrently served as Household Attendant to the Crown Prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was summoned as Chamberlain of the Imperial Treasury, soon appointed Minister of Justice, and before long concurrently served as Household Attendant to the Crown Prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 普通七年，揚州刺史臨川王宏薨，高祖與羣臣議代王居州任者久之，于時貴戚王公，咸望遷授，高祖曰：「朕已得人。
manualTranslations.literal: In Putong 7, when Hong, Prince of Linchuan and Inspector of Yangzhou, died, Gaozu discussed with his ministers for a long time who should replace the prince in the provincial post. At the time noble relatives and princes all hoped to receive the transfer, but Gaozu said, "I have already found the man.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Putong 7, when Hong, Prince of Linchuan and Inspector of Yangzhou, died, Gaozu discussed with his ministers for a long time who should replace the prince in the provincial post. At the time noble relatives and princes all hoped to receive the transfer, but Gaozu said, "I have already found the man.

manualTranslations.zh: 孔休源才識通敏，實應此選。」
manualTranslations.literal: Kong Xiuyuan is quick in talent and judgment, and truly suits this selection."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kong Xiuyuan is quick in talent and judgment, and truly suits this selection."

manualTranslations.zh: 乃授宣惠將軍、監揚州。
manualTranslations.literal: He then appointed him Xuanhui General and supervisor of Yangzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then appointed him Xuanhui General and supervisor of Yangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 休源初爲臨川王行佐，及王薨而管州任，時論榮之。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiuyuan had first served as administrative aide to the Prince of Linchuan; when the prince died and Xiuyuan took charge of the province, opinion at the time considered it an honor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiuyuan had first served as administrative aide to the Prince of Linchuan; when the prince died and Xiuyuan took charge of the province, opinion at the time considered it an honor.

manualTranslations.zh: 而神州都會，簿領殷繁，休源割斷如流，傍無私謁。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet the divine province was the capital region, and its documents and cases were heavy and complex; Xiuyuan made decisions as smoothly as flowing water and allowed no private petitions from the side.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet the divine province was the capital region, and its documents and cases were heavy and complex; Xiuyuan made decisions as smoothly as flowing water and allowed no private petitions from the side.

manualTranslations.zh: 中大通二年，加授金紫光祿大夫，監揚州如故。
manualTranslations.literal: In Zhongdatong 2, he was additionally appointed Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon, while continuing as supervisor of Yangzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhongdatong 2, he was additionally appointed Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon, while continuing as supervisor of Yangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 累表陳讓，優詔不許。
manualTranslations.literal: He repeatedly submitted memorials declining, but gracious edicts did not permit it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He repeatedly submitted memorials declining, but gracious edicts did not permit it.

manualTranslations.zh: 在州晝決辭訟，夜覽墳籍。
manualTranslations.literal: While in the province, by day he judged pleadings and lawsuits, and by night he read the ancient texts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: While in the province, by day he judged pleadings and lawsuits, and by night he read the ancient texts.

manualTranslations.zh: 每車駕巡幸，常以軍國事委之。
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever the imperial carriage went on tour, the emperor regularly entrusted him with military and state affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whenever the imperial carriage went on tour, the emperor regularly entrusted him with military and state affairs.

sourceRange.text: 敬容以名家子，弱冠選尚齊武帝女長城公主，拜駙馬都尉。天監初，爲秘書郎，歷太子舍人，尚書殿中郎，太子洗馬，中書舍人，秘書丞，遷揚州治中。出爲建安內史，清公有美績，民吏稱之。還除黃門郎，累遷太子中庶子，散騎常侍，侍中，司徒左長史。普通二年，復爲侍中，領羽林監，俄又領本州大中正。頃之，守吏部尚書，銓序明審，號爲稱職。四年，出爲招遠將軍、吳郡太守，爲政勤恤民隱，辨訟如神，視事四年，治爲天下第一。吏民詣闕請樹碑，詔許之。大通二年，徵爲中書令，未拜，復爲吏部尚書，領右軍將軍，俄加侍中。中大通元年，改太子中庶子。

manualTranslations.zh: 敬容以名家子，弱冠選尚齊武帝女長城公主，拜駙馬都尉。
manualTranslations.literal: Jingrong, as the son of a distinguished house, was selected in his early twenties to marry Emperor Wu of Qi's daughter, Princess Changcheng, and was appointed Commandant of the Horse Guards.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jingrong, as the son of a distinguished house, was selected in his early twenties to marry Emperor Wu of Qi's daughter, Princess Changcheng, and was appointed Commandant of the Horse Guards.

manualTranslations.zh: 天監初，爲秘書郎，歷太子舍人，尚書殿中郎，太子洗馬，中書舍人，秘書丞，遷揚州治中。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Tianjian he became Palace Library Gentleman, and then served successively as crown prince attendant, Palace Gentleman in the Department of State Affairs, Groom of the Crown Prince, Secretariat Drafter, and Assistant Director of the Palace Library, before being transferred to administrative aide of Yangzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianjian he became Palace Library Gentleman, and then served successively as crown prince attendant, Palace Gentleman in the Department of State Affairs, Groom of the Crown Prince, Secretariat Drafter, and Assistant Director of the Palace Library, before being transferred to administrative aide of Yangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 出爲建安內史，清公有美績，民吏稱之。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out as Interior Minister of Jian'an, where he was honest and fair and achieved an excellent record, and the people and officials praised him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He went out as Interior Minister of Jian'an, where he was honest and fair and achieved an excellent record, and the people and officials praised him.

manualTranslations.zh: 還除黃門郎，累遷太子中庶子，散騎常侍，侍中，司徒左長史。
manualTranslations.literal: On returning to court he was appointed Yellow Gate Gentleman, then rose successively to Household Attendant to the Crown Prince, Regular Attendant, Attendant-in-Ordinary, and left chief clerk to the Minister over the Masses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On returning to court he was appointed Yellow Gate Gentleman, then rose successively to Household Attendant to the Crown Prince, Regular Attendant, Attendant-in-Ordinary, and left chief clerk to the Minister over the Masses.

manualTranslations.zh: 普通二年，復爲侍中，領羽林監，俄又領本州大中正。
manualTranslations.literal: In Putong 2, he again became Attendant-in-Ordinary, concurrently director of the Feathered Forest Guard, and soon also served as grand rectifier of his home province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Putong 2, he again became Attendant-in-Ordinary, concurrently director of the Feathered Forest Guard, and soon also served as grand rectifier of his home province.

manualTranslations.zh: 頃之，守吏部尚書，銓序明審，號爲稱職。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long, he acted as Minister of Personnel; his selection and ordering of officials were clear and careful, and he was considered competent in the post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long, he acted as Minister of Personnel; his selection and ordering of officials were clear and careful, and he was considered competent in the post.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，出爲招遠將軍、吳郡太守，爲政勤恤民隱，辨訟如神，視事四年，治爲天下第一。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, he went out as General Who Summons the Distant and administrator of Wu Commandery. In governing he diligently cared for the people's hardships and judged lawsuits with almost uncanny precision. After four years in office, his administration was ranked first in the realm.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, he went out as General Who Summons the Distant and administrator of Wu Commandery. In governing he diligently cared for the people's hardships and judged lawsuits with almost uncanny precision. After four years in office, his administration was ranked first in the realm.

manualTranslations.zh: 吏民詣闕請樹碑，詔許之。
manualTranslations.literal: The officials and people went to the palace gate to request permission to erect a stele, and an edict allowed it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The officials and people went to the palace gate to request permission to erect a stele, and an edict allowed it.

manualTranslations.zh: 大通二年，徵爲中書令，未拜，復爲吏部尚書，領右軍將軍，俄加侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: In Datong 2, he was summoned as Secretariat Director, but before taking office he was again made Minister of Personnel, concurrently General of the Right Army, and soon additionally Attendant-in-Ordinary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong 2, he was summoned as Secretariat Director, but before taking office he was again made Minister of Personnel, concurrently General of the Right Army, and soon additionally Attendant-in-Ordinary.

manualTranslations.zh: 中大通元年，改太子中庶子。
manualTranslations.literal: In Zhongdatong 1, he was changed to Household Attendant to the Crown Prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhongdatong 1, he was changed to Household Attendant to the Crown Prince.

sourceRange.text: 」太清元年，遷太子詹事，侍中如故。二年，侯景襲京師，敬容自府移家臺內。初，景于渦陽退敗，未得審實，傳者乃云其將暴顯反，景身與衆並沒，朝廷以爲憂。敬容尋見東宮，太宗謂曰：「淮北始更有信，侯景定得身免，不如所傳。」敬容對曰：「得景遂死，深是朝廷之福。」太宗失色，問其故。敬容曰：「景翻覆叛臣，終當亂國。」是年，太宗頻於玄圃自講《老》《莊》二書，學士吳孜時寄詹事府，每日入聽。敬容謂孜曰：「昔晉代喪亂，頗由祖尚玄虛，胡賊殄覆中夏。今東宮復襲此，殆非人事，其將爲戎乎？」俄而侯景難作，其言有徵也。三年正月，敬容卒于圍內，詔贈仁威將軍，本官並如故。

manualTranslations.zh: 太清元年，遷太子詹事，侍中如故。
manualTranslations.literal: In Taiqing 1, he was transferred to Crown Prince's Household Administrator, remaining Attendant-in-Ordinary as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Taiqing 1, he was transferred to Crown Prince's Household Administrator, remaining Attendant-in-Ordinary as before.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，侯景襲京師，敬容自府移家臺內。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, when Hou Jing attacked the capital, Jingrong moved his household from his office into the imperial compound.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, when Hou Jing attacked the capital, Jingrong moved his household from his office into the imperial compound.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，景于渦陽退敗，未得審實，傳者乃云其將暴顯反，景身與衆並沒，朝廷以爲憂。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, when Jing had been defeated at Guoyang and no verified report had yet arrived, rumor said that his general Bao Xian had rebelled and that Jing himself and his troops had all perished, and the court was anxious over it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Jing had been defeated at Guoyang and no verified report had yet arrived, rumor said that his general Bao Xian had rebelled and that Jing himself and his troops had all perished, and the court was anxious over it.

manualTranslations.zh: 敬容尋見東宮，太宗謂曰：「淮北始更有信，侯景定得身免，不如所傳。」
manualTranslations.literal: Jingrong soon had an audience in the Eastern Palace, and Taizong said to him, "News has only just come again from north of the Huai: Hou Jing certainly escaped alive, not as the rumors said."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jingrong soon had an audience in the Eastern Palace, and Taizong said to him, "News has only just come again from north of the Huai: Hou Jing certainly escaped alive, not as the rumors said."

manualTranslations.zh: 敬容對曰：「得景遂死，深是朝廷之福。」
manualTranslations.literal: Jingrong replied, "If Jing had indeed died, it would be a great blessing for the court."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jingrong replied, "If Jing had indeed died, it would be a great blessing for the court."

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗失色，問其故。
manualTranslations.literal: Taizong turned pale and asked the reason.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taizong turned pale and asked the reason.

manualTranslations.zh: 敬容曰：「景翻覆叛臣，終當亂國。」
manualTranslations.literal: Jingrong said, "Jing is a treacherous rebel minister; in the end he will throw the state into disorder."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jingrong said, "Jing is a treacherous rebel minister; in the end he will throw the state into disorder."

manualTranslations.zh: 是年，太宗頻於玄圃自講《老》《莊》二書，學士吳孜時寄詹事府，每日入聽。
manualTranslations.literal: That year Taizong often personally lectured on the Laozi and Zhuangzi at Xuanpu. The scholar Wu Zi was then attached to the Crown Prince's Household Administrator's office and entered every day to listen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year Taizong often personally lectured on the Laozi and Zhuangzi at Xuanpu. The scholar Wu Zi was then attached to the Crown Prince's Household Administrator's office and entered every day to listen.

manualTranslations.zh: 敬容謂孜曰：「昔晉代喪亂，頗由祖尚玄虛，胡賊殄覆中夏。
manualTranslations.literal: Jingrong said to Zi, "In the past, the disasters and disorder of the Jin were largely due to esteeming abstruse emptiness, and Hu bandits destroyed the central realm.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jingrong said to Zi, "In the past, the disasters and disorder of the Jin were largely due to esteeming abstruse emptiness, and Hu bandits destroyed the central realm.

manualTranslations.zh: 今東宮復襲此，殆非人事，其將爲戎乎？」
manualTranslations.literal: Now the Eastern Palace is taking this up again. This scarcely seems like a human matter; is it about to become a barbarian calamity?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now the Eastern Palace is taking this up again. This scarcely seems like a human matter; is it about to become a barbarian calamity?"

manualTranslations.zh: 俄而侯景難作，其言有徵也。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon Hou Jing's calamity broke out, and his words were borne out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon Hou Jing's calamity broke out, and his words were borne out.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年正月，敬容卒于圍內，詔贈仁威將軍，本官並如故。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of the third year, Jingrong died inside the siege. An edict posthumously granted him the title General of Benevolent Awe, with all his regular offices as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year, Jingrong died inside the siege. An edict posthumously granted him the title General of Benevolent Awe, with all his regular offices as before.

sourceRange.text: 天監十一年，遷侍中。十四年，出爲寧遠將軍、豫章內史，爲政和理，甚得民心。十八年，復入爲侍中，領步兵校尉。普通元年，出爲貞毅將軍、太尉臨川王長史。四年，入爲左民尚書。其年遷掌吏部，尋以公事免。五年，起爲太子中庶子，領右軍將軍。六年，復爲左民尚書，領步兵校尉。俄徙爲吏部尚書，尋加侍中。出爲仁威將軍、晉陵太守。在郡清靜，百姓化其德，境內肅然。罷郡還，吏民詣闕請立碑，詔許之。大通二年，入爲侍中、五兵尚書，未拜，遷掌吏部，侍中如故。舉祖莊，宋世再典選，至舉又三爲此職，前代未有也。

manualTranslations.literal: In the fourteenth year, he went out as General Who Pacifies the Distant and Interior Minister of Yuzhang. His governance was harmonious and orderly, and he greatly won the hearts of the people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, he went out as General Who Pacifies the Distant and Interior Minister of Yuzhang. His governance was harmonious and orderly, and he greatly won the hearts of the people.

manualTranslations.zh: 十八年，復入爲侍中，領步兵校尉。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighteenth year, he again entered court as Attendant-in-Ordinary, concurrently Infantry Colonel.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, he again entered court as Attendant-in-Ordinary, concurrently Infantry Colonel.

manualTranslations.zh: 普通元年，出爲貞毅將軍、太尉臨川王長史。
manualTranslations.literal: In Putong 1, he went out as General of Firm Resoluteness and chief clerk to the Prince of Linchuan, Grand Commandant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Putong 1, he went out as General of Firm Resoluteness and chief clerk to the Prince of Linchuan, Grand Commandant.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，入爲左民尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, he entered court as Minister of the Left People.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, he entered court as Minister of the Left People.

manualTranslations.zh: 其年遷掌吏部，尋以公事免。
manualTranslations.literal: That year he was transferred to administer the Ministry of Personnel, but soon was dismissed over an official matter.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year he was transferred to administer the Ministry of Personnel, but soon was dismissed over an official matter.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，起爲太子中庶子，領右軍將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, he was recalled as Household Attendant to the Crown Prince, concurrently General of the Right Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, he was recalled as Household Attendant to the Crown Prince, concurrently General of the Right Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，復爲左民尚書，領步兵校尉。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year, he again became Minister of the Left People, concurrently Infantry Colonel.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, he again became Minister of the Left People, concurrently Infantry Colonel.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄徙爲吏部尚書，尋加侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was shifted to Minister of Personnel, and before long was additionally Attendant-in-Ordinary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was shifted to Minister of Personnel, and before long was additionally Attendant-in-Ordinary.

manualTranslations.zh: 出爲仁威將軍、晉陵太守。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out as General of Benevolent Awe and administrator of Jinling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He went out as General of Benevolent Awe and administrator of Jinling.

manualTranslations.zh: 在郡清靜，百姓化其德，境內肅然。
manualTranslations.literal: In the commandery he was clear and tranquil; the common people were transformed by his virtue, and the territory was orderly and respectful.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the commandery he was clear and tranquil; the common people were transformed by his virtue, and the territory was orderly and respectful.

manualTranslations.zh: 罷郡還，吏民詣闕請立碑，詔許之。
manualTranslations.literal: When he left the commandery and returned to court, the officials and people went to the palace gate to request permission to erect a stele, and an edict allowed it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he left the commandery and returned to court, the officials and people went to the palace gate to request permission to erect a stele, and an edict allowed it.

manualTranslations.zh: 大通二年，入爲侍中、五兵尚書，未拜，遷掌吏部，侍中如故。
manualTranslations.literal: In Datong 2, he entered court as Attendant-in-Ordinary and Minister of the Five Armies, but before taking office was transferred to administer the Ministry of Personnel, remaining Attendant-in-Ordinary as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong 2, he entered court as Attendant-in-Ordinary and Minister of the Five Armies, but before taking office was transferred to administer the Ministry of Personnel, remaining Attendant-in-Ordinary as before.

manualTranslations.zh: 舉祖莊，宋世再典選，至舉又三爲此職，前代未有也。
manualTranslations.literal: Ju's grandfather Zhuang had twice managed personnel selection in the Song period; down to Ju, who held this office three more times, there had been no such precedent in earlier ages.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ju's grandfather Zhuang had twice managed personnel selection in the Song period; down to Ju, who held this office three more times, there had been no such precedent in earlier ages.

sourceRange.text: 大同四年，遷右衛將軍。六年，异啓於儀賢堂奉述高祖《老子義》，敕許之。及就講，朝士及道俗聽者千餘人，爲一時之盛。時城西又開士林館以延學士，异與左丞賀琛遞日述高祖《禮記中庸義》，皇太子又召异於玄圃講《易》。八年，改加侍中。太清元年，遷左衛將軍，領步兵。二年，遷中領軍，舍人如故。

sourceRange.text: __TOC__滕曇恭，豫章南昌人也。年五歲，母楊氏患熱，思食寒瓜，土俗所不產。曇恭歷訪不能得，銜悲哀切。俄值一桑門問其故，曇恭具以告。桑門曰：「我有兩瓜，分一相遺。」曇恭拜謝，因捧瓜還，以薦其母。舉室驚異。尋訪桑門，莫知所在。及父母卒，曇恭水漿不入口者旬日，感慟嘔血，絕而復蘇。隆冬不著繭絮，蔬食終身。每至忌日，思慕不自堪，晝夜哀慟。其門外有冬生樹二株，時忽有神光自樹而起，俄見佛像及夾侍之儀，容光顯著，自門而入。曇恭家人大小，咸共禮拜，久之乃滅，遠近道俗咸傳之。太守王僧度引曇恭爲功曹，固辭不就。王儉時隨僧度在郡，號爲滕曾子。天監元年，陸璉奉使巡行風俗，表言其狀。曇恭有子三人，皆有行業。

manualTranslations.literal: Teng Tangong came from Nanchang in Yuzhang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Teng Tangong came from Nanchang in Yuzhang.

manualTranslations.zh: 年五歲，母楊氏患熱，思食寒瓜，土俗所不產。
manualTranslations.literal: When he was five, his mother, Lady Yang, suffered from a fever and longed to eat cold melon, but the local custom did not produce it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he was five, his mother, Lady Yang, suffered from a fever and longed to eat cold melon, but the local custom did not produce it.

manualTranslations.zh: 曇恭歷訪不能得，銜悲哀切。
manualTranslations.literal: Tangong searched everywhere but could not obtain any, and he held grief in his heart with deep sorrow.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tangong searched everywhere but could not obtain any, and he held grief in his heart with deep sorrow.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄值一桑門問其故，曇恭具以告。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he encountered a Buddhist monk who asked the reason, and Tangong told him everything.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he encountered a Buddhist monk who asked the reason, and Tangong told him everything.

manualTranslations.zh: 桑門曰：「我有兩瓜，分一相遺。」
manualTranslations.literal: The monk said, "I have two melons; I will give you one of them."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The monk said, "I have two melons; I will give you one of them."

manualTranslations.zh: 曇恭拜謝，因捧瓜還，以薦其母。
manualTranslations.literal: Tangong bowed in thanks, then carried the melon home and presented it to his mother.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tangong bowed in thanks, then carried the melon home and presented it to his mother.

manualTranslations.zh: 舉室驚異。
manualTranslations.literal: The whole household was amazed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The whole household was amazed.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋訪桑門，莫知所在。
manualTranslations.literal: When they soon searched for the monk, no one knew where he was.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When they soon searched for the monk, no one knew where he was.

manualTranslations.zh: 及父母卒，曇恭水漿不入口者旬日，感慟嘔血，絕而復蘇。
manualTranslations.literal: When his parents died, Tangong took neither water nor gruel for ten days; overcome with grief, he vomited blood, lost consciousness, and then revived.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When his parents died, Tangong took neither water nor gruel for ten days; overcome with grief, he vomited blood, lost consciousness, and then revived.

manualTranslations.zh: 隆冬不著繭絮，蔬食終身。
manualTranslations.literal: In the depth of winter he wore no padded silk or floss, and he ate vegetables for the rest of his life.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the depth of winter he wore no padded silk or floss, and he ate vegetables for the rest of his life.

manualTranslations.zh: 每至忌日，思慕不自堪，晝夜哀慟。
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever the death anniversaries arrived, longing overcame him, and he wailed in grief day and night.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whenever the death anniversaries arrived, longing overcame him, and he wailed in grief day and night.

manualTranslations.zh: 其門外有冬生樹二株，時忽有神光自樹而起，俄見佛像及夾侍之儀，容光顯著，自門而入。
manualTranslations.literal: Outside his gate stood two winter-growing trees. At one point divine light suddenly rose from the trees, and soon a Buddha image and attendant figures appeared, their radiant forms clearly visible, entering through the gate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Outside his gate stood two winter-growing trees. At one point divine light suddenly rose from the trees, and soon a Buddha image and attendant figures appeared, their radiant forms clearly visible, entering through the gate.

manualTranslations.zh: 曇恭家人大小，咸共禮拜，久之乃滅，遠近道俗咸傳之。
manualTranslations.literal: All the members of Tangong's household, great and small, bowed in worship together; after a long while it vanished, and Daoists, Buddhists, and laypeople far and near all passed on the story.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All the members of Tangong's household, great and small, bowed in worship together; after a long while it vanished, and Daoists, Buddhists, and laypeople far and near all passed on the story.

manualTranslations.zh: 太守王僧度引曇恭爲功曹，固辭不就。
manualTranslations.literal: Administrator Wang Sengdu summoned Tangong to serve as merit officer, but he firmly declined and did not take the post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Administrator Wang Sengdu summoned Tangong to serve as merit officer, but he firmly declined and did not take the post.

manualTranslations.zh: 王儉時隨僧度在郡，號爲滕曾子。
manualTranslations.literal: Wang Jian was then in the commandery with Sengdu and called him Teng Zengzi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Jian was then in the commandery with Sengdu and called him Teng Zengzi.

manualTranslations.zh: 天監元年，陸璉奉使巡行風俗，表言其狀。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianjian 1, Lu Lian received an imperial mission to inspect local customs and submitted a memorial describing Tangong's conduct.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjian 1, Lu Lian received an imperial mission to inspect local customs and submitted a memorial describing Tangong's conduct.

manualTranslations.zh: 曇恭有子三人，皆有行業。
manualTranslations.literal: Tangong had three sons, all of whom had virtuous conduct.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tangong had three sons, all of whom had virtuous conduct.

sourceRange.text: ，詔曰：「二漢登賢，莫非經術，服膺雅道，名立行成。

localRange.text: 漢氏承秦燔書，大弘儒訓，太學生徒，動以萬數，郡國黌舍，悉皆充滿。學於山澤者，至或就爲列肆，其盛也如是。漢末喪亂，其道遂衰。魏正始以後，仍尚玄虛之學，爲儒者蓋寡。時荀顗、摯虞之徒，雖刪定新禮，改官職，未能易俗移風。自是中原橫潰，衣冠殄盡；江左草創，日不暇給；以迄于宋、齊。國學時或開置，而勸課未博，建之不及十年，蓋取文具，廢之多歷世祀，其棄也忽諸。鄉里莫或開館，公卿罕通經術。朝廷大儒，獨學而弗肯養衆；後生孤陋，擁經而無所講習。三德六藝，其廢久矣。高祖有天下，深愍之，詔求碩學，治五禮，定六律，改鬥曆，正權衡。天監四年，詔曰：「二漢登賢，莫非經術，服膺雅道，名立行成。

sourceRange.text: 吳均字叔庠，吳興故鄣人也。家世寒賤，至均好學有俊才。沈約嘗見均文，頗相稱賞。天監初，柳惲爲吳興，召補主簿，日引與賦詩。均文體清拔有古氣，好事者或斅之，謂爲「吳均體」。建安王偉爲揚州，引兼記室，掌文翰。王遷江州，補國侍郎，兼府城局。還除奉朝請。先是，均表求撰《齊春秋》。尋有敕召見，使撰《通史》，起三皇，訖齊代，均草本紀、世家功已畢，唯列傳未就。普通元年，卒，時年五十二。均注范曄《後漢書》九十卷，著《齊春秋》三十卷、《廟記》十卷、《十二州記》十六卷、《錢唐先賢傳》五卷、《續文釋》五卷，文集二十卷。

localRange.text: 《易》曰：「君子遁世無悶，獨立不懼。孔子稱長沮、桀溺隱者也。古之隱者，或恥聞禪代，高讓帝王，以萬乘爲垢辱，之死亡而無悔。此則輕生重道，希世間出，隱之上者也。或託仕監門，寄臣柱下，居易而以求其志，處汙而不愧其色。此所謂大隱隱於市朝，又其次也。或裸體佯狂，盲喑絕世，棄禮樂以反道，忍孝慈而不恤。此全身遠害，得大雅之道，又其次也。然同不失語默之致，有幽人貞吉矣。與夫沒身亂世，爭利干時者，豈同年而語哉！《孟子》曰：「今人之於爵祿，得之若其生，失之若其死。《淮南子》曰：「人皆鑒於止水，不鑒於流潦。夫可以揚清激濁，抑貪止競，其惟隱者乎！自古帝王，莫不崇尚其道。雖唐堯不屈巢、許，周武不降夷、齊；以漢高肆慢而長揖黃、綺，光武按法而折意嚴、周；自茲以來，世有人矣！有梁之盛，繼紹風猷。斯乃道德可宗，學藝可範，故以備《處士篇》云。

localRange.text: 《易》曰：「亢之爲言也，知進而不知退，知存而不知亡。知進退存亡而不失其正者，其唯聖人乎！《傳》曰：「知足不辱，知止不殆。然則不知夫進退，不達乎止足，殆辱之累，期月而至矣。古人之進也，以康世濟務也，以弘道厲俗也。然其進也，光寵夷易，故愚夫之所乾沒；其退也，苦節艱貞，故庸曹之所忌憚。雖禍敗危亡，陳乎耳目，而輕舉高蹈，寡乎前史。漢世張良功成身退，病臥卻粒，比於樂毅、范蠡至乎顛狽，斯爲優矣。其後薛廣德及二疏等，去就以禮，有可稱焉。魚豢《魏略·知足傳》，方田、徐於管、胡，則其道本異。謝靈運《晉書·止足傳》，先論晉世文士之避亂者，殆非其人；唯阮思曠遺榮好遁，遠殆辱矣。《宋書·止足傳》有羊欣、王微，咸其流亞。齊時沛國劉瓛，字子珪，辭祿懷道，棲遲養志，不戚戚於貧賤，不耽耽於富貴，儒行之高者也。梁有天下，小人道消，賢士大夫相招在位，其量力守志，則當世罔聞，時或有致事告老，或有寡志少欲，國史書之，亦以爲《止足傳》云。顧憲之

sourceRange.text: 遷司徒諮議參軍、通直散騎常侍。高祖平京邑，霸府建，引爲驃騎功曹參軍，遷尚書左丞。出爲輔國長史、會稽郡丞、行郡府事。時承凋弊之後，百姓凶荒，所在穀貴，米至數千，民多流散，蓽撫循甚有治理。唯守公祿，清節逾厲，至有經日不舉火。太守、襄陽王聞而饋之，蓽謝不受。天監元年，卒，停屍無以殮，柩不能歸。高祖聞之，詔賜絹百匹、米五十斛。初，蓽爲西楚望族，早歷顯官，鄉人樂藹有幹用，素與蓽不平，互相陵競。藹事齊豫章王嶷，嶷薨，藹仕不得志，自步兵校尉求助戍歸荊州，時蓽爲州別駕，益忽藹。及高祖踐阼，藹以西朝勳爲御史中丞，蓽始得會稽行事，旣恥之矣；會職事微有譴，高祖以藹其鄉人也，使宣旨誨之，蓽大憤，故發病卒。

context.beforeSource: 明帝聞而嘉焉，手敕褒美，州里榮之。
context.afterSource: 沈瑀字伯瑜，吳興武康人也。

manualTranslations.zh: 遷司徒諮議參軍、通直散騎常侍。
manualTranslations.literal: Bi was promoted to advisory army aide to the Minister over the Masses and Direct Regular Attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖平京邑，霸府建，引爲驃騎功曹參軍，遷尚書左丞。
manualTranslations.literal: After Gaozu pacified the capital and established his hegemon's headquarters, he brought Bi in as merit officer army aide to the General of Agile Cavalry, and Bi was transferred to Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Gaozu pacified the capital and established his hegemon's headquarters, he brought Bi in as merit officer army aide to the General of Agile Cavalry, and Bi was transferred to Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 出爲輔國長史、會稽郡丞、行郡府事。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out as chief clerk to the General Who Assists the State, assistant administrator of Kuaiji Commandery, and acting head of the commandery office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He went out as chief clerk to the General Who Assists the State, assistant administrator of Kuaiji Commandery, and acting head of the commandery office.

manualTranslations.zh: 時承凋弊之後，百姓凶荒，所在穀貴，米至數千，民多流散，蓽撫循甚有治理。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time, after devastation and exhaustion, the people suffered famine, grain was expensive everywhere, rice rose to several thousand cash, and many people fled and scattered; Bi comforted and guided them and governed very effectively.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time, after devastation and exhaustion, the people suffered famine, grain was expensive everywhere, rice rose to several thousand cash, and many people fled and scattered; Bi comforted and guided them and governed very effectively.

manualTranslations.zh: 唯守公祿，清節逾厲，至有經日不舉火。
manualTranslations.literal: He kept only his official salary, and his pure integrity became still more austere, to the point that for days at a time his household did not light a cooking fire.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He kept only his official salary, and his pure integrity became still more austere, to the point that for days at a time his household did not light a cooking fire.

manualTranslations.zh: 太守、襄陽王聞而饋之，蓽謝不受。
manualTranslations.literal: The administrator, the Prince of Xiangyang, heard of this and sent him gifts, but Bi thanked him and would not accept them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The administrator, the Prince of Xiangyang, heard of this and sent him gifts, but Bi thanked him and would not accept them.

manualTranslations.zh: 天監元年，卒，停屍無以殮，柩不能歸。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianjian 1, he died; there was nothing with which to shroud the body, and the coffin could not be sent home.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjian 1, he died; there was nothing with which to shroud the body, and the coffin could not be sent home.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖聞之，詔賜絹百匹、米五十斛。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu heard of it, he issued an edict granting one hundred bolts of silk and fifty hu of rice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu heard of it, he issued an edict granting one hundred bolts of silk and fifty hu of rice.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，蓽爲西楚望族，早歷顯官，鄉人樂藹有幹用，素與蓽不平，互相陵競。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, Bi belonged to a prominent clan of western Chu and had long held distinguished offices. His fellow countryman Yue Ai had administrative ability but had never been on good terms with Bi, and the two slighted and competed with each other.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, Bi belonged to a prominent clan of western Chu and had long held distinguished offices. His fellow countryman Yue Ai had administrative ability but had never been on good terms with Bi, and the two slighted and competed with each other.

manualTranslations.zh: 藹事齊豫章王嶷，嶷薨，藹仕不得志，自步兵校尉求助戍歸荊州，時蓽爲州別駕，益忽藹。
manualTranslations.literal: Ai served Yi, Prince of Yuzhang under Qi. When Yi died, Ai was frustrated in office and, from his post as Infantry Colonel, requested auxiliary garrison duty and returned to Jingzhou. At the time Bi was provincial vice administrator and slighted Ai even more.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ai served Yi, Prince of Yuzhang under Qi. When Yi died, Ai was frustrated in office and, from his post as Infantry Colonel, requested auxiliary garrison duty and returned to Jingzhou. At the time Bi was provincial vice administrator and slighted Ai even more.

manualTranslations.zh: 及高祖踐阼，藹以西朝勳爲御史中丞，蓽始得會稽行事，旣恥之矣；
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu ascended the throne, Ai became censor-in-chief because of his merit in the western court, while Bi had only just obtained acting charge of Kuaiji affairs; Bi was already ashamed of this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu ascended the throne, Ai became censor-in-chief because of his merit in the western court, while Bi had only just obtained acting charge of Kuaiji affairs; Bi was already ashamed of this.

manualTranslations.zh: 會職事微有譴，高祖以藹其鄉人也，使宣旨誨之，蓽大憤，故發病卒。
manualTranslations.literal: When a minor reprimand arose over official business, Gaozu, because Ai was Bi's countryman, had Ai convey his instructions and admonish him. Bi was greatly enraged, fell ill, and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When a minor reprimand arose over official business, Gaozu, because Ai was Bi's countryman, had Ai convey his instructions and admonish him. Bi was greatly enraged, fell ill, and died.

localRange.text: 昔漢宣帝以爲「政平訟理，其惟良二千石乎！前史亦云：「今之郡守，古之諸侯也。故長吏之職，號爲親民，是以導德齊禮，移風易俗，咸必由之。齊末昏亂，政移羣小，賦調雲起，徭役無度。守宰多倚附權門，互長貪虐，掊克聚斂，侵愁細民，天下搖動，無所厝其手足。高祖在田，知民疾苦，及梁臺建，仍下寬大之書，昏時雜調，咸悉除省，於是四海之內，始得息肩。逮踐皇極，躬覽庶事，日昃聽政，求民之瘼。乃命輶軒以省方俗，置肺石以達窮民，務加隱卹，舒其急病。元年，始去人貲，計丁爲布；身服浣濯之衣，御府無文飾，宮掖不過綾彩，無珠璣錦繡；太官撤牢饌，每日膳菜蔬，飲酒不過三盞：以儉先海內。每選長吏，務簡廉平，皆召見御前，親勗治道。始擢尚書殿中郎到溉爲建安內史，左民侍郎劉鬷爲晉安太守，溉等居官，並以廉潔著。又著令：小縣有能，遷爲大縣；大縣有能，遷爲二千石。於是山陰令丘仲孚治有異績，以爲長沙內史；武康令何遠清公，以爲宣城太守。剖符爲吏者，往往承風焉。若新野庾蓽諸任職者，以經術潤飾吏政，或所居流惠，或去後見思，蓋後來之良吏也。綴爲《良吏篇》云。

sourceRange.text: 齊初，爲寧朔將軍、錢唐令，治煩以簡，獄無繫囚。及去官，百姓以謙在職不受餉遺，追載縑帛以送之，謙卻不受。每去官，輒無私宅，常借官空車廄居焉。永明初，爲冠軍長史、江夏太守，坐被代輒去郡，繫尚方。頃之，免爲中散大夫。明帝將廢立，欲引謙爲心膂，使兼衛尉，給甲仗百人，謙不願處際會，輒散甲士，帝雖不罪，而弗復任焉。出爲南中郎司馬。東昏永元元年，遷囗囗大夫。

context.beforeSource: 及建平誅，遷左軍將軍。
context.afterSource: 天監六年，出爲輔國將軍、零陵太守，已衰老，猶強力爲政，吏民安之。

manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Qi, Qian served as General Who Pacifies the North and magistrate of Qiantang. He governed complexity with simplicity, and the jail held no prisoners.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Qi, Qian served as General Who Pacifies the North and magistrate of Qiantang. He governed complexity with simplicity, and the jail held no prisoners.

manualTranslations.zh: 及去官，百姓以謙在職不受餉遺，追載縑帛以送之，謙卻不受。
manualTranslations.literal: When he left office, the people, because Qian had accepted no food or gifts while in office, chased after him carrying silk to send him off, but Qian declined and would not accept it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he left office, the people, because Qian had accepted no food or gifts while in office, chased after him carrying silk to send him off, but Qian declined and would not accept it.

manualTranslations.zh: 每去官，輒無私宅，常借官空車廄居焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever he left office, he had no private residence and often borrowed an empty government carriage stable to live in.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whenever he left office, he had no private residence and often borrowed an empty government carriage stable to live in.

manualTranslations.zh: 永明初，爲冠軍長史、江夏太守，坐被代輒去郡，繫尚方。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Yongming, he became chief clerk to the Champion General and administrator of Jiangxia. Because he left the commandery immediately after being replaced, he was imprisoned in the imperial workshops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yongming, he became chief clerk to the Champion General and administrator of Jiangxia. Because he left the commandery immediately after being replaced, he was imprisoned in the imperial workshops.

manualTranslations.zh: 頃之，免爲中散大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long, he was released and made Palace Grandee.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long, he was released and made Palace Grandee.

manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Ming was about to depose and install a ruler, he wished to draw Qian in as a trusted aide, made him acting Commandant of the Guards, and gave him one hundred armored guards. sourceRange.text: 盤盤國，宋文帝元嘉，孝武孝建、大明中，並遣使貢獻。大通元年，其王使使奉表曰：「揚州閻浮提震旦天子：萬善莊嚴，一切恭敬，猶如天淨無雲，明耀滿目；天子身心清淨，亦復如是。道俗濟濟，並蒙聖王光化，濟度一切，永作舟航，臣聞之慶善。我等至誠敬禮常勝天子足下，稽首問訊。今奉薄獻，願垂哀受。」中大通元年五月，累遣使貢牙像及塔，幷獻沉檀等香數十種。六年八月，復使送菩提國真舍利及畫塔，幷獻菩提樹葉、詹糖等香。丹丹國，中大通二年，其王遣使奉表曰：「伏承聖主至德仁治，信重三寶，佛法興顯，衆僧殷集，法事日盛，威嚴整肅。朝望國執，慈愍蒼生，八方六合，莫不歸服。化鄰諸天，非可言喻。不任慶善，若暫奉見尊足。謹奉送牙像及塔各二軀，幷獻火齊珠、吉貝、雜香藥等。」大同元年，復遣使獻金、銀、琉璃、雜寶、香藥等物。

sourceRange.text: 梁興，進代爲征西將軍。代死，子休運籌襲爵位。天監十三年，遣使獻金裝馬腦鐘二口，又表於益州立九層佛寺，詔許焉。十五年，又遣使獻赤舞龍駒及方物。其使或歲再三至，或再歲一至。其地與益州鄰，常通商賈，民慕其利，多往從之，教其書記，爲之辭譯，稍桀黠矣。普通元年，又奉獻方物。籌死，子呵羅真立。大通三年，詔以爲寧西將軍、護羌校尉、西秦、河二州刺史。真死，子佛輔襲爵位，其世子又遣使獻白龍駒於皇太子。

items.sourceTextOverride: 梁興，進代爲征西將軍。代死，子休運籌襲爵位。天監十三年，遣使獻金裝馬腦鐘二口，又表於益州立九層佛寺，詔許焉。十五年，又遣使獻赤舞龍駒及方物。其使或歲再三至，或再歲一至。其地與益州鄰，常通商賈，民慕其利，多往從之，教其書記，爲之辭譯，稍桀黠矣。普通元年，又奉獻方物。籌死，子呵羅真立。大通三年，詔以爲寧西將軍、護羌校尉、西秦、河二州刺史。真死，子佛輔襲爵位，其世子又遣使獻白龍駒於皇太子。

manualTranslations.zh: 梁興，進代爲征西將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Liang arose, Dai was advanced to General Who Campaigns West.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Liang arose, Dai was advanced to General Who Campaigns West.

manualTranslations.zh: 代死，子休運籌襲爵位。
manualTranslations.literal: When Dai died, his son Xiuyunchou inherited his rank and titles.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Dai died, his son Xiuyunchou inherited his rank and titles.

manualTranslations.zh: 天監十三年，遣使獻金裝馬腦鐘二口，又表於益州立九層佛寺，詔許焉。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianjian 13, he sent envoys to offer two agate bells with gold fittings, and he also submitted a memorial requesting permission to establish a nine-story Buddhist temple in Yizhou; an edict allowed it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjian 13, he sent envoys to offer two agate bells with gold fittings, and he also submitted a memorial requesting permission to establish a nine-story Buddhist temple in Yizhou; an edict allowed it.

manualTranslations.zh: 十五年，又遣使獻赤舞龍駒及方物。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifteenth year, he again sent envoys to offer a red Dancing-Dragon colt and local products.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, he again sent envoys to offer a red Dancing-Dragon colt and local products.

manualTranslations.zh: 其使或歲再三至，或再歲一至。
manualTranslations.literal: Their envoys sometimes came two or three times in a year, and sometimes once every two years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Their envoys sometimes came two or three times in a year, and sometimes once every two years.

manualTranslations.zh: 其地與益州鄰，常通商賈，民慕其利，多往從之，教其書記，爲之辭譯，稍桀黠矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Their land bordered Yizhou and regularly exchanged merchants with it. People sought the profit and often went to join them, teaching them writing and documents and serving as interpreters for them, so they gradually became crafty and shrewd.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Their land bordered Yizhou and regularly exchanged merchants with it. People sought the profit and often went to join them, teaching them writing and documents and serving as interpreters for them, so they gradually became crafty and shrewd.

manualTranslations.zh: 普通元年，又奉獻方物。
manualTranslations.literal: In Putong 1, they again presented local products.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Putong 1, they again presented local products.

manualTranslations.zh: 籌死，子呵羅真立。
manualTranslations.literal: When Chou died, his son Heluozhen took the throne.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Chou died, his son Heluozhen took the throne.

manualTranslations.zh: 大通三年，詔以爲寧西將軍、護羌校尉、西秦、河二州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In Datong 3, an edict made Zhen General Who Pacifies the West, Protector of the Qiang, and inspector of West Qin and He provinces.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong 3, an edict made Zhen General Who Pacifies the West, Protector of the Qiang, and inspector of West Qin and He provinces.

manualTranslations.zh: 真死，子佛輔襲爵位，其世子又遣使獻白龍駒於皇太子。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhen died, his son Fofu inherited his rank and titles, and his heir again sent an envoy to offer a white dragon colt to the crown prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhen died, his son Fofu inherited his rank and titles, and his heir again sent an envoy to offer a white dragon colt to the crown prince.

sourceRange.text: 又西南萬里有海人，身黑眼白，裸而醜，其肉羙，行者或射而食之。文身國，在倭國東北七千餘里。人體有文如獸，其額上有三文，文直者貴，文小者賤。土俗歡樂，物豐而賤，行客不齎粮。有屋宇，無城郭。其王所居，飾以金銀珍麗。繞屋爲壍，廣一丈，實以水銀，雨則流于水銀之上。市用珍寶。犯輕罪者則鞭仗，犯死罪則置猛獸食之，有枉則猛獸避而不食，經宿則赦之。

sourceRange.text: 晉武帝太康中，尋始遣使貢獻。穆帝升平元年，王竺旃檀奉表獻馴象。詔曰：「此物勞費不少，駐令勿送。」其後王憍陳如，本天竺婆羅門也。有神語曰「應王扶南」，憍陳如心悅，南至盤盤，扶南人聞之，舉國欣戴，迎而立焉。復改制度，用天竺法。憍陳如死，後王持梨陁跋摩，宋文帝世奉表獻方物。齊永明中，王闍邪跋摩遣使貢獻。

context.beforeSource: 大家乃截錦爲之，貧者乃用布。
context.afterSource: 天監二年，跋摩復遣使送珊瑚佛像，幷獻方物。
context.beforeLocal: 大家乃截錦爲之，貧者乃用布。
context.afterLocal: 天監二年，跋摩復遣使送珊瑚佛像，幷獻方物。

sourceRange.text: 芮芮國，蓋匈奴別種。魏、晉世，匈奴分爲數百千部，各有名號，芮芮其一部也。自元魏南遷，因擅其故地。無城郭，隨水草畜牧，以穹廬爲居。辮髮，衣錦，小袖袍，小口袴，深雍靴。其地苦寒，七月流澌亘河。宋升明中，遣王洪軌使焉，引之共伐魏。齊建元元年，洪軌始至其國，國王率三十萬騎，出燕然山東南三千餘里，魏人閉關不敢戰。後稍侵弱。永明中，爲丁零所破，更爲小國而南移其居。天監中，始破丁零，復其舊土。始築城郭，名曰木末城。十四年，遣使獻烏貂裘。普通元年，又遣使獻方物。是後數歲一至焉。大同七年，又獻馬一匹、金一斤。

context.afterSource: 其國能以術祭天而致風雪，前對皎日，後則泥潦橫流，故其戰敗莫能追及。

items.sourceTextOverride: 芮芮國，蓋匈奴別種。魏、晉世，匈奴分爲數百千部，各有名號，芮芮其一部也。自元魏南遷，因擅其故地。無城郭，隨水草畜牧，以穹廬爲居。辮髮，衣錦，小袖袍，小口袴，深雍靴。其地苦寒，七月流澌亘河。宋升明中，遣王洪軌使焉，引之共伐魏。齊建元元年，洪軌始至其國，國王率三十萬騎，出燕然山東南三千餘里，魏人閉關不敢戰。後稍侵弱。永明中，爲丁零所破，更爲小國而南移其居。天監中，始破丁零，復其舊土。始築城郭，名曰木末城。十四年，遣使獻烏貂裘。普通元年，又遣使獻方物。是後數歲一至焉。大同七年，又獻馬一匹、金一斤。

manualTranslations.zh: 芮芮國，蓋匈奴別種。
manualTranslations.literal: The kingdom of Rouran was probably a separate stock of the Xiongnu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The kingdom of Rouran was probably a separate stock of the Xiongnu.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏、晉世，匈奴分爲數百千部，各有名號，芮芮其一部也。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Wei and Jin periods, the Xiongnu divided into hundreds and thousands of groups, each with its own name; Rouran was one of these groups.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the Wei and Jin periods, the Xiongnu divided into hundreds and thousands of groups, each with its own name; Rouran was one of these groups.

manualTranslations.zh: 自元魏南遷，因擅其故地。
manualTranslations.literal: After Northern Wei moved south, Rouran took possession of its former territory.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Northern Wei moved south, Rouran took possession of its former territory.

manualTranslations.zh: 無城郭，隨水草畜牧，以穹廬爲居。
manualTranslations.literal: They had no walled cities; they followed water and pasture with their herds and lived in domed tents.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They had no walled cities; they followed water and pasture with their herds and lived in domed tents.

manualTranslations.zh: 辮髮，衣錦，小袖袍，小口袴，深雍靴。
manualTranslations.literal: They braided their hair and wore brocade, small-sleeved robes, narrow-legged trousers, and deep boots.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They braided their hair and wore brocade, small-sleeved robes, narrow-legged trousers, and deep boots.

manualTranslations.zh: 其地苦寒，七月流澌亘河。
manualTranslations.literal: Their land was bitterly cold; in the seventh month, floating ice stretched across the rivers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Their land was bitterly cold; in the seventh month, floating ice stretched across the rivers.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋升明中，遣王洪軌使焉，引之共伐魏。
manualTranslations.literal: During Song's Shengming era, Wang Honggui was sent as envoy to them to draw them into a joint attack on Wei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Song's Shengming era, Wang Honggui was sent as envoy to them to draw them into a joint attack on Wei.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊建元元年，洪軌始至其國，國王率三十萬騎，出燕然山東南三千餘里，魏人閉關不敢戰。
manualTranslations.literal: In Qi Jianyuan 1, Honggui first reached their state. The king led three hundred thousand cavalry out more than three thousand li southeast of Mount Yanran, and the Wei closed their passes and did not dare fight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qi Jianyuan 1, Honggui first reached their state. The king led three hundred thousand cavalry out more than three thousand li southeast of Mount Yanran, and the Wei closed their passes and did not dare fight.

manualTranslations.zh: 後稍侵弱。
manualTranslations.literal: Later they gradually declined and weakened.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later they gradually declined and weakened.

manualTranslations.zh: 永明中，爲丁零所破，更爲小國而南移其居。
manualTranslations.literal: During Yongming, they were defeated by the Dingling, again became a small state, and moved their settlements south.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Yongming, they were defeated by the Dingling, again became a small state, and moved their settlements south.

manualTranslations.zh: 天監中，始破丁零，復其舊土。
manualTranslations.literal: During Tianjian, they finally defeated the Dingling and recovered their old territory.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Tianjian, they finally defeated the Dingling and recovered their old territory.

manualTranslations.zh: 始築城郭，名曰木末城。
manualTranslations.literal: They then began building a walled city, called Mumo City.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They then began building a walled city, called Mumo City.

manualTranslations.zh: 十四年，遣使獻烏貂裘。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourteenth year, they sent envoys to offer black marten coats.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, they sent envoys to offer black marten coats.

manualTranslations.zh: 普通元年，又遣使獻方物。
manualTranslations.literal: In Putong 1, they again sent envoys to offer local products.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Putong 1, they again sent envoys to offer local products.

manualTranslations.zh: 是後數歲一至焉。
manualTranslations.literal: After this, they came once every several years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After this, they came once every several years.

manualTranslations.zh: 大同七年，又獻馬一匹、金一斤。
manualTranslations.literal: In Datong 7, they again offered one horse and one jin of gold.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong 7, they again offered one horse and one jin of gold.

sourceRange.text: 大通元年，後王伽葉伽羅訶梨邪使奉表曰：「謹白大梁明主：雖山海殊隔，而音信時通。伏承皇帝道德高遠，覆載同於天地，明照齊乎日月，四海之表，無有不從，方國諸王，莫不奉獻，以表慕義之誠。或泛海三年，陸行千日，畏威懷德，無遠不至。我先王以來，唯以脩德爲本，不嚴而治。奉事正法道天下，欣人爲善，慶若己身，欲與大梁共弘三寶，以度難化。信還，伏聽告敕。今奉薄獻，願垂納受。

manualTranslations.zh: 大通元年，後王伽葉伽羅訶梨邪使奉表曰：「謹白大梁明主：雖山海殊隔，而音信時通。
manualTranslations.literal: In Datong 1, the later king Jiaye Jialuoheliye sent an envoy to present a memorial saying, "Respectfully to the enlightened ruler of Great Liang: although mountains and seas separate us, messages pass between us from time to time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong 1, the later king Jiaye Jialuoheliye sent an envoy to present a memorial saying, "Respectfully to the enlightened ruler of Great Liang: although mountains and seas separate us, messages pass between us from time to time.

manualTranslations.zh: 伏承皇帝道德高遠，覆載同於天地，明照齊乎日月，四海之表，無有不從，方國諸王，莫不奉獻，以表慕義之誠。
manualTranslations.literal: We respectfully hear that the emperor's Way and virtue are lofty and far-reaching, that his covering and support are like Heaven and Earth, and that his bright illumination equals the sun and moon. Beyond the four seas, there are none who do not follow him, and the kings of the various states all present tribute to show their sincere admiration for righteousness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We respectfully hear that the emperor's Way and virtue are lofty and far-reaching, that his covering and support are like Heaven and Earth, and that his bright illumination equals the sun and moon. Beyond the four seas, there are none who do not follow him, and the kings of the various states all present tribute to show their sincere admiration for righteousness.

manualTranslations.zh: 或泛海三年，陸行千日，畏威懷德，無遠不至。
manualTranslations.literal: Some float across the seas for three years or travel overland for a thousand days; awed by his majesty and cherishing his virtue, no distance keeps them from arriving.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Some float across the seas for three years or travel overland for a thousand days; awed by his majesty and cherishing his virtue, no distance keeps them from arriving.

manualTranslations.zh: 我先王以來，唯以脩德爲本，不嚴而治。
manualTranslations.literal: Since the time of our former kings, we have taken the cultivation of virtue as our foundation and have governed without harshness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since the time of our former kings, we have taken the cultivation of virtue as our foundation and have governed without harshness.

manualTranslations.zh: 奉事正法道天下，欣人爲善，慶若己身，欲與大梁共弘三寶，以度難化。
manualTranslations.literal: We serve the True Law and guide the world, rejoice when others do good as though it were our own joy, and wish together with Great Liang to spread the Three Jewels and transform those difficult to save.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We serve the True Law and guide the world, rejoice when others do good as though it were our own joy, and wish together with Great Liang to spread the Three Jewels and transform those difficult to save.

manualTranslations.zh: 信還，伏聽告敕。
manualTranslations.literal: When this message returns, we respectfully await your instructions and commands.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When this message returns, we respectfully await your instructions and commands.

manualTranslations.zh: 今奉薄獻，願垂納受。」
manualTranslations.literal: Now we present this meager tribute; may you deign to accept it."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now we present this meager tribute; may you deign to accept it."

sourceRange.text: 晉咸和中，丹陽尹高悝行至張侯橋，見浦中五色光長數尺，不知何怪，乃令人於光處掊視之，得金像，未有光趺。悝乃下車，載像還，至長幹巷首，牛不肯進，悝乃令馭人任牛所之。牛徑牽車至寺，悝因留像付寺僧。每至中夜，常放光明，又聞空中有金石之響。經一歲，捕魚人張係世，於海口忽見有銅花趺浮出水上，係世取送縣，縣以送臺，乃施像足，宛然合。會簡文咸安元年，交州合浦人董宗之采珠沒水，於底得佛光豔，交州押送臺，以施像，又合焉。自咸和中得像，至咸安初，歷三十餘年，光趺始具。
