manualTranslations.zh: 晉咸和中，丹陽尹高悝行至張侯橋，見浦中五色光長數尺，不知何怪，乃令人於光處掊視之，得金像，未有光趺。
manualTranslations.literal: During Jin's Xianhe era, Gao Kui, intendant of Danyang, was traveling to Zhanghou Bridge when he saw in the inlet a five-colored light several chi long. Not knowing what marvel it was, he had men dig and inspect the place where the light appeared; they found a gold image, though it did not yet have its shining pedestal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Jin's Xianhe era, Gao Kui, intendant of Danyang, was traveling to Zhanghou Bridge when he saw in the inlet a five-colored light several chi long. Not knowing what marvel it was, he had men dig and inspect the place where the light appeared; they found a gold image, though it did not yet have its shining pedestal.

manualTranslations.zh: 悝乃下車，載像還，至長幹巷首，牛不肯進，悝乃令馭人任牛所之。
manualTranslations.literal: Kui got down from his carriage, loaded the image, and returned. When they reached the head of Changgan Lane, the ox refused to go forward, so Kui ordered the driver to let the ox go where it wished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kui got down from his carriage, loaded the image, and returned. When they reached the head of Changgan Lane, the ox refused to go forward, so Kui ordered the driver to let the ox go where it wished.

manualTranslations.zh: 牛徑牽車至寺，悝因留像付寺僧。
manualTranslations.literal: The ox pulled the cart straight to the temple, and Kui left the image there with the monks.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The ox pulled the cart straight to the temple, and Kui left the image there with the monks.

manualTranslations.zh: 每至中夜，常放光明，又聞空中有金石之響。
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever midnight came, it would emit light, and sounds of metal and stone were also heard in the air.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whenever midnight came, it would emit light, and sounds of metal and stone were also heard in the air.

manualTranslations.zh: 經一歲，捕魚人張係世，於海口忽見有銅花趺浮出水上，係世取送縣，縣以送臺，乃施像足，宛然合。
manualTranslations.literal: After a year, the fisherman Zhang Xishi suddenly saw at the sea mouth a bronze lotus pedestal floating on the water. Xishi took it and sent it to the county, and the county sent it to the imperial offices; when it was set beneath the image's feet, it fit perfectly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After a year, the fisherman Zhang Xishi suddenly saw at the sea mouth a bronze lotus pedestal floating on the water. Xishi took it and sent it to the county, and the county sent it to the imperial offices; when it was set beneath the image's feet, it fit perfectly.

manualTranslations.zh: 會簡文咸安元年，交州合浦人董宗之采珠沒水，於底得佛光豔，交州押送臺，以施像，又合焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Then, in Jianwen's Xian'an 1, Dong Zongzhi of Hepu in Jiaozhou was diving for pearls when he found a brilliant Buddha halo at the bottom. Jiaozhou escorted it to the imperial offices; when it was attached to the image, it also fit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Then, in Jianwen's Xian'an 1, Dong Zongzhi of Hepu in Jiaozhou was diving for pearls when he found a brilliant Buddha halo at the bottom. Jiaozhou escorted it to the imperial offices; when it was attached to the image, it also fit.

manualTranslations.zh: 自咸和中得像，至咸安初，歷三十餘年，光趺始具。
manualTranslations.literal: From the discovery of the image in the Xianhe era to the beginning of Xian'an, more than thirty years passed before the halo and pedestal were complete.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From the discovery of the image in the Xianhe era to the beginning of Xian'an, more than thirty years passed before the halo and pedestal were complete.

sourceRange.text: 十年、十三年，跋摩累遣使貢獻。其年死，庶子留陁跋摩殺其嫡弟自立。十六年，遣使竺當抱老奉表貢獻。十八年，復遣使送天竺旃檀瑞像、婆羅樹葉，幷獻火齊珠、鬱金、蘇合等香。普通元年、中大通二年、大同元年，累遣使瑞獻方物。五年，復遣使獻生犀。又言其國有佛髮，長一丈二尺，詔遣沙門釋雲寶隨使往迎之。

sourceRange.text: 孝武建元、大明中，林邑王范神成累遣長史奉表貢獻。明帝泰豫元年，又遣使獻方物。齊永明中，範文贊累遣使貢獻。天監九年，文贊子天凱奉獻白猴，詔曰：「林邑王范天凱介在海表，乃心款至，遠修職貢，良有可嘉。宜班爵號，被以榮澤。可持節、督緣海諸軍事、威南將軍、林邑王。」十年，十三年，天凱累遣使獻方物。俄而病死，子弼毳跋摩立，奉表貢獻。普通七年，王高式勝鎧遣使獻方物，詔以爲持節、督緣海諸軍事、綏南將軍、林邑王。大通元年，又遣使貢獻。中大通二年，行林邑王高式律陁羅跋摩遣使貢獻，詔以爲持節、督緣海諸軍事、綏南將軍、林邑王。六年，又遣使獻方物。

sourceRange.text: 侯景__TOC__侯景，字萬景，朔方人，或云雁門人。少而不羈，見憚鄉里。及長，驍勇有膂力，善騎射。以選爲北鎮戍兵，稍立功效。魏孝昌元年，有懷朔鎮兵鮮于脩禮，於定州作亂，攻沒郡縣；又有柔玄鎮兵吐斤洛周，率其黨與，復寇幽、冀，與脩禮相合，衆十餘萬。後脩禮見殺，部下潰散，懷朔鎮將葛榮因收集之，攻殺吐斤洛周，盡有其衆，謂之「葛賊」。四年，魏明帝殂，其后胡氏臨朝，天柱將軍尒朱榮自晉陽入弒胡氏，幷誅其親屬。景始以私衆見榮，榮甚奇景，卽委以軍事。會葛賊南逼，榮自討，命景先驅，至河內擊大破之，生擒葛榮，以功擢爲定州刺史、大行臺，封濮陽郡公。景自是威名遂著。頃之，齊神武帝爲魏相，又入洛誅尒朱氏，景復以衆降之，仍爲神武所用。景性殘忍酷虐，馭軍嚴整；然破掠所得財寶，皆班賜將士，故咸爲之用，所向多捷。總攬兵權，與神武相亞。魏以爲司徒、南道行臺，擁衆十萬，專制河南。及神武疾篤，謂子澄曰：「侯景狡猾多計，反覆難知，我死後，必不爲汝用。」乃爲書召景。景知之，慮及於禍，太清元年，乃遣其行臺郎中丁和來上表請降曰：:臣聞股肱體合，則四海和平；

manualTranslations.zh: 侯景
manualTranslations.literal: Hou Jing
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hou Jing

manualTranslations.zh: 侯景，字萬景，朔方人，或云雁門人。
manualTranslations.literal: Hou Jing, styled Wanjing, came from Shuofang; some say he was from Yanmen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hou Jing, styled Wanjing, came from Shuofang; some say he was from Yanmen.

manualTranslations.zh: 少而不羈，見憚鄉里。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth he was unruly and was feared in his home district.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In youth he was unruly and was feared in his home district.

manualTranslations.zh: 及長，驍勇有膂力，善騎射。
manualTranslations.literal: When he grew up, he was fierce and brave, had great bodily strength, and was skilled at riding and archery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he grew up, he was fierce and brave, had great bodily strength, and was skilled at riding and archery.

manualTranslations.zh: 以選爲北鎮戍兵，稍立功效。
manualTranslations.literal: He was selected as a garrison soldier in the northern garrisons and gradually established merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was selected as a garrison soldier in the northern garrisons and gradually established merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏孝昌元年，有懷朔鎮兵鮮于脩禮，於定州作亂，攻沒郡縣；
manualTranslations.literal: In Wei Xiaochang 1, Xianyu Xiuli, a soldier of Huaishuo Garrison, rebelled in Dingzhou and attacked and overran commanderies and counties;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Wei Xiaochang 1, Xianyu Xiuli, a soldier of Huaishuo Garrison, rebelled in Dingzhou and attacked and overran commanderies and counties;

manualTranslations.zh: 又有柔玄鎮兵吐斤洛周，率其黨與，復寇幽、冀，與脩禮相合，衆十餘萬。
manualTranslations.literal: there was also Tujin Luozhou, a soldier of Rouxuan Garrison, who led his followers to raid You and Ji again and joined forces with Xiuli, their troops numbering more than one hundred thousand.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: there was also Tujin Luozhou, a soldier of Rouxuan Garrison, who led his followers to raid You and Ji again and joined forces with Xiuli, their troops numbering more than one hundred thousand.

manualTranslations.zh: 後脩禮見殺，部下潰散，懷朔鎮將葛榮因收集之，攻殺吐斤洛周，盡有其衆，謂之「葛賊」。
manualTranslations.literal: Later Xiuli was killed and his subordinates scattered; Ge Rong, commander of Huaishuo Garrison, gathered them, attacked and killed Tujin Luozhou, took all his troops, and was called the "Ge bandit."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later Xiuli was killed and his subordinates scattered; Ge Rong, commander of Huaishuo Garrison, gathered them, attacked and killed Tujin Luozhou, took all his troops, and was called the "Ge bandit."

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，魏明帝殂，其后胡氏臨朝，天柱將軍尒朱榮自晉陽入弒胡氏，幷誅其親屬。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, Emperor Ming of Wei died, and his empress, Lady Hu, governed at court. Tianzhu General Erzhu Rong entered from Jinyang, murdered Lady Hu, and killed her relatives as well.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Emperor Ming of Wei died, and his empress, Lady Hu, governed at court. Tianzhu General Erzhu Rong entered from Jinyang, murdered Lady Hu, and killed her relatives as well.

manualTranslations.zh: 景始以私衆見榮，榮甚奇景，卽委以軍事。
manualTranslations.literal: Jing first came to Rong with his private troops; Rong considered Jing extraordinary and immediately entrusted military affairs to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jing first came to Rong with his private troops; Rong considered Jing extraordinary and immediately entrusted military affairs to him.

manualTranslations.zh: 會葛賊南逼，榮自討，命景先驅，至河內擊大破之，生擒葛榮，以功擢爲定州刺史、大行臺，封濮陽郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Ge bandits pressed south, Rong personally campaigned against them and ordered Jing to serve as vanguard. Reaching Henei, Jing attacked and crushed them, captured Ge Rong alive, and for this merit was promoted to inspector of Dingzhou and Grand Mobile Bureau, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Puyang Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Ge bandits pressed south, Rong personally campaigned against them and ordered Jing to serve as vanguard. Reaching Henei, Jing attacked and crushed them, captured Ge Rong alive, and for this merit was promoted to inspector of Dingzhou and Grand Mobile Bureau, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Puyang Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 景自是威名遂著。
manualTranslations.literal: From this point Jing's awe-inspiring reputation became famous.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From this point Jing's awe-inspiring reputation became famous.

manualTranslations.zh: 頃之，齊神武帝爲魏相，又入洛誅尒朱氏，景復以衆降之，仍爲神武所用。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long, Emperor Shenwu of Qi became Wei's chancellor and entered Luoyang to exterminate the Erzhu clan; Jing again surrendered to him with his troops and was then employed by Shenwu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long, Emperor Shenwu of Qi became Wei's chancellor and entered Luoyang to exterminate the Erzhu clan; Jing again surrendered to him with his troops and was then employed by Shenwu.

manualTranslations.zh: 景性殘忍酷虐，馭軍嚴整；
manualTranslations.literal: Jing was cruel, brutal, and harsh by nature, and he governed his army with strict order;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jing was cruel, brutal, and harsh by nature, and he governed his army with strict order;

manualTranslations.zh: 然破掠所得財寶，皆班賜將士，故咸爲之用，所向多捷。
manualTranslations.literal: yet the wealth and treasure he gained from victories and plunder he distributed among his officers and men, so they all served him, and he was usually victorious wherever he went.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: yet the wealth and treasure he gained from victories and plunder he distributed among his officers and men, so they all served him, and he was usually victorious wherever he went.

manualTranslations.zh: 總攬兵權，與神武相亞。
manualTranslations.literal: He took overall control of military power and was nearly equal to Shenwu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He took overall control of military power and was nearly equal to Shenwu.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏以爲司徒、南道行臺，擁衆十萬，專制河南。
manualTranslations.literal: Wei made him Minister over the Masses and Mobile Bureau of the Southern Circuit; he held one hundred thousand troops and exercised exclusive control over Henan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wei made him Minister over the Masses and Mobile Bureau of the Southern Circuit; he held one hundred thousand troops and exercised exclusive control over Henan.

manualTranslations.zh: 及神武疾篤，謂子澄曰：「侯景狡猾多計，反覆難知，我死後，必不爲汝用。」
manualTranslations.literal: When Shenwu became gravely ill, he told his son Cheng, "Hou Jing is crafty and full of schemes, and his turns of loyalty are hard to know. After I die, he certainly will not serve you."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Shenwu became gravely ill, he told his son Cheng, "Hou Jing is crafty and full of schemes, and his turns of loyalty are hard to know. After I die, he certainly will not serve you."

manualTranslations.zh: 乃爲書召景。
manualTranslations.literal: He then wrote a letter summoning Jing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then wrote a letter summoning Jing.
